"""`arena` command line: register, list cases, play one case or a whole set, show the board,
run the MCP server."""

import argparse
import functools
import io
import json
import logging
import os
import statistics
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

from .client import ArenaClient, ArenaError
from .play import RemoteTable, hosted, play, play_all, play_waves


def load_env(path=".env"):
    """Read KEY=VALUE lines from .env into the environment (real env vars win)."""
    p = Path(path)
    if p.is_file():
        for line in p.read_text().splitlines():
            key, sep, value = line.partition("=")
            value = value.strip().strip("\"'")
            if sep and value and not key.strip().startswith("#"):
                os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value)


AGENTS = [
    "naive", "smart", "confident", "rational", "explorer", "anchor", "switcher", "boulware", "router",
    "confident_boulware", "confident_router", "guarded_boulware", "guarded_rational", "evidence_router", "evidence_rational", "llm",
]  # fmt: skip


def agent_factory(name, data):
    from .agents import (
        AnchorAgent,
        BoulwareAgent,
        ConfidentAgent,
        ConfidentBoulwareAgent,
        ConfidentRouterAgent,
        EvidenceAgent,
        ExplorerAgent,
        GuardedAgent,
        LLMAgent,
        NaiveAgent,
        RationalAgent,
        RouterAgent,
        SmartAgent,
        SwitcherAgent,
        llm_from_env,
    )

    if name == "naive":
        return NaiveAgent
    if name == "rational":
        return RationalAgent
    if name == "explorer":
        return ExplorerAgent
    if name == "anchor":
        return AnchorAgent
    if name == "switcher":
        return SwitcherAgent
    if name == "boulware":
        return BoulwareAgent
    if name == "router":
        return RouterAgent
    if name == "smart":
        return SmartAgent
    if name == "confident":
        return ConfidentAgent
    if name == "confident_boulware":
        return ConfidentBoulwareAgent
    if name == "confident_router":
        return ConfidentRouterAgent
    if name == "guarded_boulware":
        return lambda: GuardedAgent(ConfidentBoulwareAgent())
    if name == "guarded_rational":
        return lambda: GuardedAgent(RationalAgent())
    # the evidence wrapper replaces the delegate's body and refs by design (it cites verified data)
    if name == "evidence_router":
        return lambda: EvidenceAgent(ConfidentRouterAgent(), data)
    if name == "evidence_rational":
        return lambda: EvidenceAgent(GuardedAgent(RationalAgent()), data)
    package = None
    if data:
        from .data import DataPackage

        package = DataPackage(data)
        package.lookup("")  # build the ID index once, before agents share it
    complete = llm_from_env()
    return lambda: LLMAgent(complete, package)


def summary(result):
    keep = ("deal", "supplier_id", "terms", "c_open", "c_deal", "c_best", "score")
    return {k: result.get(k) for k in keep if k in result}


def main(argv=None):
    load_env()
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="arena")
    ap.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true")
    verbose = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)  # -v also after the command
    verbose.add_argument("-v", "--verbose", action="store_true", default=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    sub.add_parser = functools.partial(sub.add_parser, parents=[verbose])
    r = sub.add_parser(
        "register", help="arena-sim only: get a simulator key (the arena's key comes from the organisers)"
    )
    r.add_argument("team_name")
    r.add_argument("event_code")
    data = {"default": os.environ.get("ARENA_DATA"), "help": "data package folder"}
    sets = {"default": "practice", "help": "practice, final or sandbox"}
    c = sub.add_parser("cases", help="list the cases you can play")
    c.add_argument("--set", **sets)
    p = sub.add_parser("play", help="play one case")
    p.add_argument("case_id")
    p.add_argument("--agent", default="naive", choices=AGENTS)
    p.add_argument("--data", **data)
    a = sub.add_parser("run", help="play every case of a set in parallel")
    a.add_argument("--set", **sets)
    a.add_argument("--agent", default="naive", choices=AGENTS)
    a.add_argument("--data", **data)
    a.add_argument("--parallel", type=int, default=8, help="cases at once (at most 10)")
    a.add_argument("--waves", type=int, default=5, help="final: stop after this many waves have closed")
    d = sub.add_parser("data", help="download and unpack the data (package, Sunday release once public)")
    d.add_argument("--out", default="data", help="folder to unpack into")
    sub.add_parser("me", help="your team: practice quota used and left, best score per case")
    b = sub.add_parser("board", help="show the leaderboard")
    b.add_argument("--set", **sets)
    m = sub.add_parser("mcp", help="run the read-only MCP server over the data (stdio)")
    m.add_argument("--data", **data)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    logging.basicConfig(
        level=logging.INFO if args.verbose else logging.WARNING,
        format="%(asctime)s %(message)s",
        datefmt="%H:%M:%S",
    )

    if args.cmd == "mcp":
        from .mcp_server import main as serve

        return serve(args.data)
    client = ArenaClient()
    if args.cmd == "register":
        out = client.register(args.team_name, args.event_code)
        print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
        print("\nA simulator key: put it into .env as ARENA_API_KEY=... while you point ARENA_URL at arena-sim.")
    elif args.cmd == "cases":
        cases = client.cases(args.set)
        playable = {c["case_id"] for c in hosted(cases)}
        for case in cases:
            mark = "" if case["case_id"] in playable else "  (not hosted: data only)"
            print(case["case_id"], case.get("type", ""), case.get("title", "") + mark, sep="  ")
    elif args.cmd == "me":
        try:
            print(json.dumps(client.me(), indent=2))
        except ArenaError as e:
            print(f"no team view on this arena ({e})" if e.status == 404 else e)
    elif args.cmd == "board":
        print(json.dumps(client.leaderboard(args.set), indent=2))
    elif args.cmd == "data":
        for name, info in client.downloads().items():
            if info.get("url"):
                zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(client.download(name))).extractall(args.out)
                print(f"{name}: {Path(args.out) / name}")
            else:
                print(f"{name}: public from {info.get('at')}")
    elif args.cmd == "play":
        table = RemoteTable(client)
        try:
            result = play(table, args.case_id, agent_factory(args.agent, args.data)())
        except ArenaError as e:  # e.g. not hosted, the quota, a paused key: the arena says why
            raise SystemExit(str(e)) from None
        print(json.dumps(summary(result), indent=2))
        replay = client.session(table.session_id).get("replay_url")
        if replay:  # the supplier's reasons, move by move: read it, improve, play again
            print(f"replay: {os.environ['ARENA_URL'].rstrip('/')}{replay}")
    elif args.set == "final":  # waits for each wave and plays its cases within the cap
        out = play_waves(client, agent_factory(args.agent, args.data), args.waves, min(args.parallel, 10))
    else:
        ids = [case["case_id"] for case in hosted(client.cases(args.set))]
        out = play_all(
            lambda: RemoteTable(client),
            ids,
            agent_factory(args.agent, args.data),
            min(args.parallel, 10),
        )
    if args.cmd == "run":
        for case_id, result in out.items():
            print(case_id, result if isinstance(result, Exception) else summary(result))
        scores = {c: r.get("score") for c, r in out.items() if isinstance(r, dict)}
        if args.set == "final" and scores:  # points so far: each wave 0-100, their sum, as the board counts
            waves = {}
            for case in client.cases("final"):  # your own case list: which wave each case was in
                waves.setdefault(case["wave"], []).append(scores.get(case["case_id"]) or 0)
            points = {n: round(100 * statistics.mean(v), 1) for n, v in sorted(waves.items())}
            print(f"waves: {points}  points so far: {round(sum(points.values()), 1)} (the board is the record)")
        elif scores and all(v is not None for v in scores.values()):
            print(f"mean score: {100 * statistics.mean(scores.values()):.1f}")
    if args.cmd in ("play", "run") and client.practice_remaining is not None:
        print(f"practice sessions left today: {client.practice_remaining}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

content.content:
**What counts:** **term sheets bind** - nothing else. **Data you cite is checked**: the reply says
`verified`, `contradicted` (a wrong figure or an unknown ID - it costs trust), `irrelevant` or
`duplicate`; whether a true argument moves the supplier, and how far, is the supplier's business.
**What you write is understood** - and has consequences, as it would with a person.

## 6. The score: total cost in €

Only the accepted term sheet scores. The case values it as the **total cost C** of covering your
**fixed need over a fixed horizon**, at the case's published rates. Every case states its
**category goal** - `stabilise`, `secure_supply`, `quality_first`, `leverage` or `routine` - and its
rates follow it. Reaching the goal is the skill.

| Part of C | How |
|---|---|
| Price | committed units × unit price; units bought before a new price takes effect at the current price |
| Uncovered need | need the deal does not cover at the fallback price, plus the goal's fallback risk on it |
| Payment, freight, lead time | interest for paying earlier than your reference; freight by Incoterm; € per day beyond your need |
| Quality, other | expected defects at the committed PPM minus chargebacks; tooling; an index clause on the case's index path, plus the goal's index risk |
| The supplier's health | strategic and bottleneck goals only: € for every margin point the deal leaves the supplier below a sustainable margin (its margin on the cash it gets) |

**Case score = (C_open − C_deal) / (C_open − C_best)**, clipped to 0…1. **C_open** is the best
opening quote. **C_best** is the cheaper of the best package any supplier in the case would ever
accept, with every valid lever applied, and your alternative - fixed per case, so good arguments
raise your score instead of moving the yardstick. **No deal** scores your alternative (0 if none);
some cases are best left without a deal. **A broken must-have** scores 0. **In the final** each
wave scores 0-100 (the mean of its case scores × 100, one decimal) and your **points so far** are the
sum of your wave scores - up to 500 after five waves. The formula is in `api.md`; `arena_kit.total_cost` computes C.

**Example** (a `leverage` case: 3 % fallback risk) - need 4,000 a year for 2 years, interest 8%,
reference 60 days. The foundry asks €43.20 for a 24-month contract at 30 days net.

| | Terms | C |
|---|---|---|
| C_open | €43.20, 30 days: 8,000 × 43.20 = 345,600, plus 30 days of early payment at 8% = 2,304 | €347,904 |
| Your deal | €41.60, 60 days: 8,000 × 41.60 = 332,800 | €332,800 |
| C_best (hidden) | €40.80, 90 days: 326,400, minus 30 days of interest saved = 2,176 | €324,224 |
| **Score** | (347,904 − 332,800) / (347,904 − 324,224) | **0.64** |

The same €41.60 for 12 months covers half your need; the rest counts at the fallback price, say
€46.00, plus 3 %: C = €355,920 - worse than the opening, score 0.

## 7. Rules

1. **Not allowed:** humans in the loop during the Live Final, attacks on the service or on other
   teams, more than one API key per team - and agents that read the live feed during the Live
   Final: the event feed, the screen and the leaderboard (`/v1/events`, `/screen`, `/leaderboard`
   and their JSON).
2. **Everything else counts** - including weaknesses you find in our bots. Replays show how every
   score came about, and the jury may weigh that in the pitches. The goal is to convince a
   realistic supplier: that is what carries over to real negotiations.
3. **One attempt per case** in the final. An abandoned case is no deal.
4. **Code freeze at Sun 12:00.** Submit on ehl.gg: your repo (the agent and a README to run it), the
   commit hash, a short description and your pitch slides (`submission.md`). The final runs that
   commit, so your agent must be running and polling before 12:00. We check the top 10 for later
   pushes. Run your agent where you like, with your own LLM keys.
5. A supplier remembers only within a case; its history with your company is in the data.
expected move of the clause's series.

**The supplier's margin** is `(value − full_cost) / value × 100`: `full_cost` is the supplier's
full cost per unit, `value` what the deal is worth to it in cash per unit - the price at its own
standard terms that would pay it the same: the price (units sold before the new price applies at
the current price), payment timing and tooling paid up front at what money is worth to **it** now
(more to a supplier short of cash), the freight leg it carries, chargebacks at the defect rate it
really has, and what a faster delivery, a larger volume or a tighter defect commitment costs or
brings it. A longer contract or an index clause is security for it, not cash, and does not count.
So a cash-short supplier that trades a lower price for faster payment is not squeezed.
You don't know its cost and rates - estimate them (should-cost data, its quotes, what it tells
you). `arena_kit.total_cost(case, terms, standard, supplier)` computes C, with
`arena_kit.cost.supplier_value` for your estimate of the supplier.

```
score = clip((C_open − C_deal) / (C_open − C_best), 0, 1)
```

`C_open`: the cheapest opening quote (among those that keep the must-haves). `C_best`: the cheaper
of your alternative and the best package any supplier in the case would accept with every valid
lever applied. No deal scores the alternative (0 if none); a broken must-have scores 0; if `C_open
− C_best` ≤ €0.01, a deal at `C_best` scores 1. Team total = mean case score × 100.

## Live Final in waves

The hidden cases come in 5 themed waves. The host introduces each wave on the big screen, then
starts it; a wave holds several cases that appear at its start, for every team at the same moment.
Before a wave starts, the API names nothing of it - not its theme, its cases or how many there are:
`GET /v1/cases?set=final` answers `403` until the first wave starts, and a session on a case of a
wave not started yet is a `404 "no such case"`, like any unknown ID. Once waves have started,
the list holds the case files of every started wave, each with four more fields:
# Known issues

The data is shaped like a real ERP extract, quirks included. None of these are errors to report.

1. Three delivery dates per PO line: requested, first confirmed and the goods-receipt posting date. OTD
   differs by 10-30 points depending on the reference date.
2. Goods receipts are posted on working days only (weekends, Bavarian holidays, August shutdown).
3. Partial deliveries (two receipts per line) and small over-deliveries within 5 %.
4. C-parts, some raw material and the motor cable are priced per 100 or per 1,000 units (`price_unit`);
   a PO line's value is qty x price / price_unit.
5. One supplier sits twice in the vendor master: `sup:71999` is the old record of `sup:70210` (renamed 2024).
6. A few PO lines use an outdated price (`price_note = stale_condition`): purchase price variance.
7. Index clauses are in `contract_clauses.csv` and in the contract text (`contracts/`).
8. Past quotes miss fields where the supplier left them out (`missing_fields`).
9. Invoices are paid late for some suppliers; a few cash discounts were taken after the discount period.
10. Complaints on small lots make PPM jumpy; read the rolling scorecard, not single lots.
11. PO lines with requested dates after 2026-09-30 are open orders without receipts.
12. Index series end at different months: each source publishes with its own lag (`index_series.csv`).
13. Small suppliers file no profit and loss account: `supplier_intel.csv` gives their turnover as a band.
14. Should-cost (`should_cost.csv`) assumes a German cost base and has an error of 5-15 %.
15. The spend cube holds about 400 further suppliers known only by name, category and spend.

`arena_kit.cost.supplier_value` for your estimate of the supplier.

```
score = clip((C_open − C_deal) / (C_open − C_best), 0, 1)
```

`C_open`: the cheapest opening quote (among those that keep the must-haves). `C_best`: the cheaper
of your alternative and the best package any supplier in the case would accept with every valid
lever applied. No deal scores the alternative (0 if none); a broken must-have scores 0; if `C_open
− C_best` ≤ €0.01, a deal at `C_best` scores 1. Team total = mean case score × 100.

## Live Final in waves

The hidden cases come in 5 themed waves. The host introduces each wave on the big screen, then
starts it; a wave holds several cases that appear at its start, for every team at the same moment.
Before a wave starts, the API names nothing of it - not its theme, its cases or how many there are:
`GET /v1/cases?set=final` answers `403` until the first wave starts, and a session on a case of a
wave not started yet is a `404 "no such case"`, like any unknown ID. Once waves have started,
the list holds the case files of every started wave, each with four more fields:
# Known issues

The data is shaped like a real ERP extract, quirks included. None of these are errors to report.

1. Three delivery dates per PO line: requested, first confirmed and the goods-receipt posting date. OTD
   differs by 10-30 points depending on the reference date.
2. Goods receipts are posted on working days only (weekends, Bavarian holidays, August shutdown).
3. Partial deliveries (two receipts per line) and small over-deliveries within 5 %.
4. C-parts, some raw material and the motor cable are priced per 100 or per 1,000 units (`price_unit`);
   a PO line's value is qty x price / price_unit.
5. One supplier sits twice in the vendor master: `sup:71999` is the old record of `sup:70210` (renamed 2024).
6. A few PO lines use an outdated price (`price_note = stale_condition`): purchase price variance.
7. Index clauses are in `contract_clauses.csv` and in the contract text (`contracts/`).
8. Past quotes miss fields where the supplier left them out (`missing_fields`).
9. Invoices are paid late for some suppliers; a few cash discounts were taken after the discount period.
10. Complaints on small lots make PPM jumpy; read the rolling scorecard, not single lots.
11. PO lines with requested dates after 2026-09-30 are open orders without receipts.
12. Index series end at different months: each source publishes with its own lag (`index_series.csv`).
13. Small suppliers file no profit and loss account: `supplier_intel.csv` gives their turnover as a band.
14. Should-cost (`should_cost.csv`) assumes a German cost base and has an error of 5-15 %.
15. The spend cube holds about 400 further suppliers known only by name, category and spend.

"""Fit the real-like supplier from evidence: the 30 real practice dumps (sim_cases/real_runs), the
real case files (sim_cases/real) and the data package. Writes sim_cases/supplier_profile.json.

    python -m arena_kit.fit_supplier [--data <data package>] [--out supplier_profile.json]

Every parameter carries `status` ("fitted" with n samples, or "assumed" with no evidence), the
evidence it comes from and its uncertainty. Nothing is invented: what the dumps cannot show is
marked assumed. Reads local files only; never calls the arena.
"""

import argparse
import glob
import itertools
import json
import re
import sqlite3
import statistics as st
from pathlib import Path

from .cost import must_haves_ok, supplier_value, total_cost

HERE = Path(__file__).parent / "sim_cases"
STD_PD = 30  # every supplier text in the dumps says "our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net"


def sheets(msg):
    """(price, payment_days) of each term sheet of a message; no payment days = the standard 30."""
    return [
        (x["terms"]["unit_price"], x["terms"].get("payment_days") or STD_PD)
        for x in (msg.get("term_sheets") or [])
        if x["terms"].get("unit_price")
    ]


def value(price, pd, r):
    """Cash-equivalent of a price at the standard payment days, for a supplier whose money costs r a year."""
    return price * (1 - r * (pd - STD_PD) / 360)


def q(xs, p):
    xs = sorted(xs)
    return xs[min(len(xs) - 1, int(p * len(xs)))] if xs else None


def spread(xs):
    return {"n": len(xs), "min": min(xs), "median": st.median(xs), "max": max(xs)} if xs else {"n": 0}


def param(status, n, evidence, uncertainty, **vals):
    return {"status": status, "n": n, "evidence": evidence, "uncertainty": uncertainty, **vals}


def load():
    runs = []
    for f in sorted(glob.glob(str(HERE / "real_runs" / "*_P*.json"))):
        d = json.load(open(f))
        case = json.load(open(HERE / "real" / f"{d['case']}.json"))
        runs.append({"agent": d["agent"], "case_id": d["case"], "case": case, "d": d, "r": d["result"]})
    return runs


def pair_rates(msgs):
    """The supplier's cost of money r from messages that quote the same offer at two payment terms."""
    out = []
    for m in msgs:
        s = sheets(m)
        for (p1, d1), (p2, d2) in itertools.combinations(s, 2):
            if d1 != d2 and p1 and p2:
                den = p1 * (d1 - STD_PD) - p2 * (d2 - STD_PD)
                if den and 0 < (r := 360 * (p1 - p2) / den) < 0.5:
                    out.append(r)
    return out


def standard_terms(case, run_results):
    """The supplier's standard terms: non-negotiated fields from any deal on the case, payment 30."""
    std = {}
    for r in run_results:
        if r["terms"]:
            std = {k: v for k, v in r["terms"].items() if k not in case["negotiable"]}
            break
    for f in case["negotiable"][1:]:
        o = case["term_options"].get(f) or [None]
        std[f] = STD_PD if f == "payment_days" else o[0]
    return std


def implied_floor(case, std, r_s, c_best, opening):
    """The supplier's floor V (cash value per unit at its standard terms) that reproduces the arena's
    C_best: bisect V so that the cheapest package it would accept (every lever) costs c_best."""
    sup = {"standard": std, "interest_rate": r_s}
    levers = case["negotiable"][1:]
    combos = [dict(zip(levers, c, strict=True)) for c in itertools.product(*[case["term_options"].get(f) or [None] for f in levers])]
    combos = [c for c in combos if must_haves_ok(case, c, std)]

    def cheapest(v):
        best = float("inf")
        for c in combos:
            a = supplier_value(case, {**c, "unit_price": 0.0}, sup)
            b = supplier_value(case, {**c, "unit_price": 1.0}, sup) - a
            best = min(best, total_cost(case, {**c, "unit_price": (v - a) / b}, std))
        return best

    lo, hi = 0.2 * opening, 1.6 * opening
    if not cheapest(lo) < c_best < cheapest(hi):
        return None
    for _ in range(60):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        lo, hi = (mid, hi) if cheapest(mid) < c_best else (lo, mid)
    return (lo + hi) / 2


def fit(data_dir):
    runs = load()
    by_case = {}
    for r in runs:
        by_case.setdefault(r["case_id"], []).append(r)
    P, table = {}, {}

    # -- supplier cost of money from price pairs at two payment terms --------------------------
    rates = {}
    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
        vals = [x for run in rs for t in run["d"]["threads"].values() for x in pair_rates([m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer"])]
        if vals:
            rates[cid] = st.median(vals)
    r_all = st.median(rates.values())
    P["supplier_interest_rate"] = param(
        "fitted", len(rates),
        "price pairs in one supplier message at two payment terms (e.g. P01: 137.50 at 60 days vs 136.40 at 30)",
        f"per-case values {spread(list(rates.values()))}; the buyer rates in the cases are 0.04-0.12; per case rate not given by the arena",
        per_case={k: round(v, 4) for k, v in rates.items()}, min=round(min(rates.values()), 4),
        median=round(r_all, 4), max=round(max(rates.values()), 4),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["standard_payment_days"] = param(
        "fitted", sum("standard Zahlungsziel is 30" in (m.get("body") or "") for run in runs for t in run["d"]["threads"].values() for m in t["messages"]),
        "the supplier texts say 'our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net' in every case that mentions it",
        "no counter-example in 30 dumps; the suppliers table has payment_days 30/45/60 for others (not used)",
        value=STD_PD,
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- opening price relative to the buyer's current/fallback price --------------------------
    opens, c_open_check = [], {}
    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
        case, b = rs[0]["case"], rs[0]["case"]["buyer"]
        std = standard_terms(case, [x["r"] for x in rs])
        ups = []
        for sup, t in rs[0]["d"]["threads"].items():
            first = next(m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer")
            op = sheets(first)[0][0]
            ref = b.get("current_unit_price") or b["fallback_unit_price"]
            kind = "current" if b.get("current_unit_price") else "fallback"
            opens.append({"case": cid, "type": case["type"], "supplier": sup, "opening": op, "ref": kind,
                          "vs_current": round(op / b["current_unit_price"], 4) if b.get("current_unit_price") else None,
                          "vs_fallback": round(op / b["fallback_unit_price"], 4)})  # fmt: skip
            ups.append(op)
        # the arena's C_open = the cheapest opening quote: does it match our standard-terms recomputation?
        cs = [total_cost(case, {**{f: std[f] for f in case["negotiable"][1:]}, "unit_price": u}, std) for u in ups]
        c_open_check[cid] = {"reported": rs[0]["r"]["c_open"], "recomputed_min": min(cs), "match_pct": round(100 * (min(cs) / rs[0]["r"]["c_open"] - 1), 3)}
    cur = [o["vs_current"] for o in opens if o["vs_current"]]
    types = {}
    for o in opens:
        if o["vs_current"]:
            types.setdefault(o["type"], []).append(o["vs_current"])
    P["opening_vs_current_price"] = param(
        "fitted", len(cur),
        "first supplier quote / the case's current_unit_price, 10 hosted cases, 12 supplier threads",
        "ratio ranges 0.91 (bundling, below current) to 1.13; by case type only 1-2 samples each; P05 (rfq) has no current price",
        by_type={k: spread(v) for k, v in types.items()}, **{k: v for k, v in spread(cur).items() if k != "n"},
        samples=sorted(cur),
    )  # fmt: skip
    fb = [o["vs_fallback"] for o in opens if o["ref"] == "fallback"]
    P["opening_vs_fallback_price_rfq"] = param(
        "fitted", len(fb), "P05 rfq: three suppliers' first quotes / the case's fallback price (no current price in rfq)",
        "one case only", samples=sorted(fb),
    )  # fmt: skip
    ann = []
    for rs in by_case.values():
        m = re.search(r"\+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?) ?%", rs[0]["case"]["title"])
        b = rs[0]["case"]["buyer"]
        if m and b.get("current_unit_price"):
            first = sheets(next(x for x in next(iter(rs[0]["d"]["threads"].values()))["messages"] if x["from"] != "buyer"))[0][0]
            ann.append((float(m[1]), round(100 * (first / b["current_unit_price"] - 1), 2)))
    P["opening_equals_announced_increase"] = param(
        "fitted", len(ann), "case title '+x %' vs opening/current - 1", "P01: +9.5 asked, +9.50 opened; P02: +6.5 vs +6.49; tiny sample",
        pairs=ann,
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- floor implied by the arena's own C_best -------------------------------------------------
    floors, floor_rows = [], {}
    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
        case, res = rs[0]["case"], rs[0]["r"]
        std = standard_terms(case, [x["r"] for x in rs])
        ok = abs(c_open_check[cid]["match_pct"]) < 0.5
        ops = [o["opening"] for o in opens if o["case"] == cid]
        row = {"c_open_matches": ok, "c_best": res["c_best"], "c_open": res["c_open"]}
        if ok and res["c_best"] < (res["c_alt"] or 1e18) - 1:
            r_s = rates.get(cid, r_all)
            lo = implied_floor(case, std, min(r_s, r_all) * 0.7, res["c_best"], min(ops))
            mid = implied_floor(case, std, r_s, res["c_best"], min(ops))
            hi = implied_floor(case, std, max(r_s, r_all) * 1.3, res["c_best"], min(ops))
            row.update(floor_ratio=round(mid / min(ops), 4) if mid else None,
                       floor_ratio_range=[round(x / min(ops), 4) for x in (lo, hi) if x],
                       r_used=round(r_s, 4), rate_fitted=cid in rates)  # fmt: skip
            if mid:
                floors.append(mid / min(ops))
        floor_rows[cid] = row
    P["floor_vs_opening"] = param(
        "fitted", len(floors),
        "the supplier's cheapest accepted package: V such that the cheapest lever package at V costs the arena's C_best (cost.supplier_value, cost.total_cost); ratio V / best opening quote",
        "assumes C_best = supplier_value floor with every lever (brief.md section 6); standard terms rebuilt from the deals; rate varies +-30%; "
        "the floors of P03/P07/P08/P18 lie far below anything a supplier conceded (it froze first), so they bound room, not behaviour",
        per_case=floor_rows, **{k: round(v, 4) for k, v in spread(floors).items() if k != "n"}, samples=sorted(round(f, 4) for f in floors),
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- concession, final offer, walk-away, claims --------------------------------------------
    g_runs, idle_steps, step1_claims, step1_plain, pass_rows = [], [], [], [], []
    finals, walks, last_ask_ratio, accepts = [], [], [], []
    for run in runs:
        cid, b = run["case_id"], run["case"]["buyer"]
        r_s = rates.get(cid, r_all)
        for sup, t in run["d"]["threads"].items():
            S = [m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer"]
            B = [m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] == "buyer" and sheets(m)]
            if not S or not sheets(S[0]):
                continue
            sv = [value(*sheets(m)[0], r_s) if sheets(m) else None for m in S]
            bv = [max(value(p, d, r_s) for p, d in sheets(m)) for m in B]
            o = sv[0]
            fin = next((i for i, m in enumerate(S) if m["status"] == "final_offer"), None)
            if fin is not None:
                last_ask_ratio.append(sv[fin] / o)
            finals.append({"run": run["agent"] + "_" + cid, "supplier": sup, "round": fin,
                           "idle_moves_before": sum(1 for i in range(1, min(fin or 0, len(bv))) if bv[i] - bv[i - 1] < 0.002 * o) if fin else None,
                           "buyer_moves_before": min(fin or 0, len(B))})  # fmt: skip
            end = min(fin if fin is not None else len(S) - 1, len(S) - 1)
            dsum = bsum = 0.0
            for i in range(1, end + 1):
                if sv[i] is None or i - 1 >= len(bv):
                    break
                ds = sv[i - 1] - sv[i]
                n_ver = sum(c.get("result") == "verified" for c in (S[i].get("claim_results") or []))
                if i == 1:
                    (step1_claims if n_ver else step1_plain).append((ds / o, n_ver))
                    continue
                db = bv[i - 1] - bv[i - 2] if i >= 2 and i - 1 < len(bv) else 0
                if db < 0.002 * o:
                    idle_steps.append(ds / o)
                else:
                    dsum, bsum = dsum + ds, bsum + db
                pass_rows.append((cid, round(db / o, 4), round(ds / o, 4)))
            if bsum > 0.01 * o:
                g_runs.append(dsum / bsum)
            # walk-away / agreement after final: pushes that did not meet the ask
            if fin is not None:
                pushes = [m for m in B[fin:] if sheets(m)]
                walked = S[-1]["status"] == "walked_away"
                (walks if walked else accepts).append({"run": run["agent"] + "_" + cid, "supplier": sup, "pushes_after_final": len(pushes)})
    P["concession_pass_through"] = param(
        "fitted", len(g_runs), "per thread: sum(supplier ask drop) / sum(our rise in the best offer's value), rounds 2..final, rounds where we moved >0.2% of the opening",
        "range is wide (P02 about 0.02: supplier froze while we moved 10 EUR; P01 about 0.4-0.6); case dependent, not predictable from case fields",
        **spread([round(g, 3) for g in g_runs]), samples=sorted(round(g, 3) for g in g_runs),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["idle_step"] = param(
        "fitted", len(idle_steps), "supplier ask drop per round (share of opening) in rounds where we moved <0.2% of the opening",
        "mostly 0 or tiny; sometimes a small step; samples listed", **spread([round(x, 4) for x in idle_steps]), samples=sorted(round(x, 4) for x in idle_steps),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["first_reply_drop_with_verified_claims"] = param(

    wp = [w["pushes_after_final"] for w in walks]

    P["final_offer_ask_vs_opening"] = param(
        "fitted", len(last_ask_ratio), "value of the final_offer / opening value (at the standard payment days)",
        "the supplier's frozen position: how far it actually came down in 30 runs", **spread([round(x, 4) for x in last_ask_ratio]),

    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- term trades and hard limits ---------------------------------------------------------
    texts = [(run["case_id"], s, m.get("body") or "") for run in runs for s, t in run["d"]["threads"].items() for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer"]
    limit_threads = {(c, s) for c, s, b in texts if "absolute limit" in b and "30 days" in b}
    all_threads = {(c, s) for c, s, _ in texts}
    cap_threads = {(c, s) for c, s, b in texts if "allocation cap" in b}
    P["payment_days_trade"] = param(
        "fitted", len(rates), "= supplier_interest_rate: a longer payment term costs the buyer about r * days / 360 of the price",

    )  # fmt: skip
    P["payment_days_hard_limit_30"] = param(
        "fitted", len(all_threads), f"'30 days is our absolute limit / strictly tied to 30 days' said by {sorted(limit_threads)}",
        "2 of 12 threads (17%); the quoted threads are small owner-run shops (rfq P05); the others traded 60/90 days for a higher price",
        share=round(len(limit_threads) / len(all_threads), 3),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["volume_cap"] = param(
        "fitted", len(cap_threads), f"P10 capacity: 'our allocation cap strictly limits the volume to 19,890 pieces per year' (middle of options 16379/19890/23400); {sorted(cap_threads)}",
        "one case; no evidence on whether a premium lifts the cap (the must-have asks >= 22230, the supplier would not move)",
        cap_option_index=1,
    )  # fmt: skip
    asked = []
    con = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{Path(data_dir) / 'world.sqlite'}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    for a, s_ in con.execute("select asked_pct, settled_pct from negotiation_history where asked_pct is not null and settled_pct is not null"):
        if a > 0:
            asked.append(round(s_ / a, 3))
    P["history_settle_share_of_ask"] = param(
        "fitted", len(asked), "world.sqlite negotiation_history: settled_pct / asked_pct for past asks > 0 (share of a price increase the supplier kept)",
        "past real-world events of the fictional firm, not arena sessions; the arena's suppliers may differ; used as a cross-check of the floor, not in the mock",
        **spread(asked), q25=q(asked, 0.25), q75=q(asked, 0.75),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["accept_tolerance"] = param(
        "fitted", 3, "agreed at an offer worth less than its ask: P03 (value -1.1%: 438.21 at 90 vs at 30 days) and P07 (-1% pd); refused P01 (-1.6%) and P05 70210 (30 vs 90 days)",
        "bounds only: tolerance in about [0.011, 0.016) of the ask value; assumed uniform inside", min=0.0, max=0.016,

    P["answers_to_questions"] = param(
        "fitted", 7, "supplier questions in the dumps: 'Which volume can you commit to?' (P03,P08,P10, when we have a volume term), "
        "'Which figures is that based on / please send the data' (P01, after an unsupported claim of analysis); 'breakdown' requests answered by cost-breakdown.xlsx",
        "no dump shows a concession after we answer; the mock only asks and ignores the answer (assumed), cited facts that verify earn the first-reply bonus",
    )  # fmt: skip
    for k in ("jitter_between_runs",):
        P[k] = param(
            "assumed", 0, "same case and supplier gave identical openings and the same ask path in different agents' runs (P02: 373.64 in all three)",
            "not tested: whether suppliers are random; seed jitter in the mock is assumed", value=0.01,
        )  # fmt: skip
    return {
        "meta": {"source": "sim_cases/real_runs (30 dumps, 10 cases) + sim_cases/real + data package", "cases": sorted(by_case), "c_open_check": c_open_check},
        "parameters": P,
        "pass_through_rows": pass_rows,
        "opening_rows": opens,
    }


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("--data", default=str(Path.home() / "Documents/Codex/negotiation-arena-kit/data"))
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=str(HERE / "supplier_profile.json"))
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    out = fit(a.data)
    Path(a.out).write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    for k, v in out["parameters"].items():
        print(f"{k:42} {v['status']:8} n={v['n']:<3}", {x: v[x] for x in ("min", "median", "max", "value") if x in v})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Fit the real-like supplier from evidence: the 30 real practice dumps (sim_cases/real_runs), the
real case files (sim_cases/real) and the data package. Writes sim_cases/supplier_profile.json.

    python -m arena_kit.fit_supplier [--data <data package>] [--out supplier_profile.json]

Every parameter carries `status` ("fitted" with n samples, or "assumed" with no evidence), the
evidence it comes from and its uncertainty. Nothing is invented: what the dumps cannot show is
marked assumed. Reads local files only; never calls the arena.
"""

import argparse
import glob
import itertools
import json
import re
import sqlite3
import statistics as st
from pathlib import Path

from .cost import must_haves_ok, supplier_value, total_cost

HERE = Path(__file__).parent / "sim_cases"
STD_PD = 30  # every supplier text in the dumps says "our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net"


def sheets(msg):
    """(price, payment_days) of each term sheet of a message; no payment days = the standard 30."""
    return [
        (x["terms"]["unit_price"], x["terms"].get("payment_days") or STD_PD)
        for x in (msg.get("term_sheets") or [])
        if x["terms"].get("unit_price")
    ]


def value(price, pd, r):
    """Cash-equivalent of a price at the standard payment days, for a supplier whose money costs r a year."""
    return price * (1 - r * (pd - STD_PD) / 360)


def q(xs, p):
    xs = sorted(xs)
    return xs[min(len(xs) - 1, int(p * len(xs)))] if xs else None


def spread(xs):
    return {"n": len(xs), "min": min(xs), "median": st.median(xs), "max": max(xs)} if xs else {"n": 0}


def param(status, n, evidence, uncertainty, **vals):
    return {"status": status, "n": n, "evidence": evidence, "uncertainty": uncertainty, **vals}


def load():
    runs = []
    for f in sorted(glob.glob(str(HERE / "real_runs" / "*_P*.json"))):
        d = json.load(open(f))
        case = json.load(open(HERE / "real" / f"{d['case']}.json"))
        runs.append({"agent": d["agent"], "case_id": d["case"], "case": case, "d": d, "r": d["result"]})
    return runs


def pair_rates(msgs):
    """The supplier's cost of money r from messages that quote the same offer at two payment terms."""
    out = []
    for m in msgs:
        s = sheets(m)
        for (p1, d1), (p2, d2) in itertools.combinations(s, 2):
            if d1 != d2 and p1 and p2:
                den = p1 * (d1 - STD_PD) - p2 * (d2 - STD_PD)
                if den and 0 < (r := 360 * (p1 - p2) / den) < 0.5:
                    out.append(r)
    return out


def standard_terms(case, run_results):
    """The supplier's standard terms: non-negotiated fields from any deal on the case, payment 30."""
    std = {}
    for r in run_results:
        if r["terms"]:
            std = {k: v for k, v in r["terms"].items() if k not in case["negotiable"]}
            break
    for f in case["negotiable"][1:]:
        o = case["term_options"].get(f) or [None]
        std[f] = STD_PD if f == "payment_days" else o[0]
    return std


def implied_floor(case, std, r_s, c_best, opening):
    """The supplier's floor V (cash value per unit at its standard terms) that reproduces the arena's
    C_best: bisect V so that the cheapest package it would accept (every lever) costs c_best."""
    sup = {"standard": std, "interest_rate": r_s}
    levers = case["negotiable"][1:]
    combos = [dict(zip(levers, c, strict=True)) for c in itertools.product(*[case["term_options"].get(f) or [None] for f in levers])]
    combos = [c for c in combos if must_haves_ok(case, c, std)]

    def cheapest(v):
        best = float("inf")
        for c in combos:
            a = supplier_value(case, {**c, "unit_price": 0.0}, sup)
            b = supplier_value(case, {**c, "unit_price": 1.0}, sup) - a
            best = min(best, total_cost(case, {**c, "unit_price": (v - a) / b}, std))
        return best

    lo, hi = 0.2 * opening, 1.6 * opening
    if not cheapest(lo) < c_best < cheapest(hi):
        return None
    for _ in range(60):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        lo, hi = (mid, hi) if cheapest(mid) < c_best else (lo, mid)
    return (lo + hi) / 2


def fit(data_dir):
    runs = load()
    by_case = {}
    for r in runs:
        by_case.setdefault(r["case_id"], []).append(r)
    P, table = {}, {}

    # -- supplier cost of money from price pairs at two payment terms --------------------------
    rates = {}
    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
        vals = [x for run in rs for t in run["d"]["threads"].values() for x in pair_rates([m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer"])]
        if vals:
            rates[cid] = st.median(vals)
    r_all = st.median(rates.values())
    P["supplier_interest_rate"] = param(
        "fitted", len(rates),
        "price pairs in one supplier message at two payment terms (e.g. P01: 137.50 at 60 days vs 136.40 at 30)",
        f"per-case values {spread(list(rates.values()))}; the buyer rates in the cases are 0.04-0.12; per case rate not given by the arena",
        per_case={k: round(v, 4) for k, v in rates.items()}, min=round(min(rates.values()), 4),
        median=round(r_all, 4), max=round(max(rates.values()), 4),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["standard_payment_days"] = param(
        "fitted", sum("standard Zahlungsziel is 30" in (m.get("body") or "") for run in runs for t in run["d"]["threads"].values() for m in t["messages"]),
        "the supplier texts say 'our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net' in every case that mentions it",
        "no counter-example in 30 dumps; the suppliers table has payment_days 30/45/60 for others (not used)",
        value=STD_PD,
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- opening price relative to the buyer's current/fallback price --------------------------
    opens, c_open_check = [], {}
    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
        case, b = rs[0]["case"], rs[0]["case"]["buyer"]
        std = standard_terms(case, [x["r"] for x in rs])
        ups = []
        for sup, t in rs[0]["d"]["threads"].items():
            first = next(m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer")
            op = sheets(first)[0][0]
            ref = b.get("current_unit_price") or b["fallback_unit_price"]
            kind = "current" if b.get("current_unit_price") else "fallback"
            opens.append({"case": cid, "type": case["type"], "supplier": sup, "opening": op, "ref": kind,
                          "vs_current": round(op / b["current_unit_price"], 4) if b.get("current_unit_price") else None,
                          "vs_fallback": round(op / b["fallback_unit_price"], 4)})  # fmt: skip
            ups.append(op)
        # the arena's C_open = the cheapest opening quote: does it match our standard-terms recomputation?
        cs = [total_cost(case, {**{f: std[f] for f in case["negotiable"][1:]}, "unit_price": u}, std) for u in ups]
        c_open_check[cid] = {"reported": rs[0]["r"]["c_open"], "recomputed_min": min(cs), "match_pct": round(100 * (min(cs) / rs[0]["r"]["c_open"] - 1), 3)}
    cur = [o["vs_current"] for o in opens if o["vs_current"]]
    types = {}
    for o in opens:
        if o["vs_current"]:
            types.setdefault(o["type"], []).append(o["vs_current"])
    P["opening_vs_current_price"] = param(
        "fitted", len(cur),
        "first supplier quote / the case's current_unit_price, 10 hosted cases, 12 supplier threads",
        "ratio ranges 0.91 (bundling, below current) to 1.13; by case type only 1-2 samples each; P05 (rfq) has no current price",
        by_type={k: spread(v) for k, v in types.items()}, **{k: v for k, v in spread(cur).items() if k != "n"},
        samples=sorted(cur),
    )  # fmt: skip
    fb = [o["vs_fallback"] for o in opens if o["ref"] == "fallback"]
    P["opening_vs_fallback_price_rfq"] = param(
        "fitted", len(fb), "P05 rfq: three suppliers' first quotes / the case's fallback price (no current price in rfq)",
        "one case only", samples=sorted(fb),
    )  # fmt: skip
    ann = []
    for rs in by_case.values():
        m = re.search(r"\+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?) ?%", rs[0]["case"]["title"])
        b = rs[0]["case"]["buyer"]
        if m and b.get("current_unit_price"):
            first = sheets(next(x for x in next(iter(rs[0]["d"]["threads"].values()))["messages"] if x["from"] != "buyer"))[0][0]
            ann.append((float(m[1]), round(100 * (first / b["current_unit_price"] - 1), 2)))
    P["opening_equals_announced_increase"] = param(
        "fitted", len(ann), "case title '+x %' vs opening/current - 1", "P01: +9.5 asked, +9.50 opened; P02: +6.5 vs +6.49; tiny sample",
        pairs=ann,
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- floor implied by the arena's own C_best -------------------------------------------------
    floors, floor_rows = [], {}
    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
        case, res = rs[0]["case"], rs[0]["r"]
        std = standard_terms(case, [x["r"] for x in rs])
        ok = abs(c_open_check[cid]["match_pct"]) < 0.5
        ops = [o["opening"] for o in opens if o["case"] == cid]
        row = {"c_open_matches": ok, "c_best": res["c_best"], "c_open": res["c_open"]}
        if ok and res["c_best"] < (res["c_alt"] or 1e18) - 1:
            r_s = rates.get(cid, r_all)
            lo = implied_floor(case, std, min(r_s, r_all) * 0.7, res["c_best"], min(ops))
            mid = implied_floor(case, std, r_s, res["c_best"], min(ops))
            hi = implied_floor(case, std, max(r_s, r_all) * 1.3, res["c_best"], min(ops))
            row.update(floor_ratio=round(mid / min(ops), 4) if mid else None,
                       floor_ratio_range=[round(x / min(ops), 4) for x in (lo, hi) if x],
                       r_used=round(r_s, 4), rate_fitted=cid in rates)  # fmt: skip
            if mid:
                floors.append(mid / min(ops))
        floor_rows[cid] = row
    P["floor_vs_opening"] = param(
        "fitted", len(floors),
        "the supplier's cheapest accepted package: V such that the cheapest lever package at V costs the arena's C_best (cost.supplier_value, cost.total_cost); ratio V / best opening quote",
        "assumes C_best = supplier_value floor with every lever (brief.md section 6); standard terms rebuilt from the deals; rate varies +-30%; "
        "the floors of P03/P07/P08/P18 lie far below anything a supplier conceded (it froze first), so they bound room, not behaviour",
        per_case=floor_rows, **{k: round(v, 4) for k, v in spread(floors).items() if k != "n"}, samples=sorted(round(f, 4) for f in floors),
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- concession, final offer, walk-away, claims --------------------------------------------
    g_runs, idle_steps, step1_claims, step1_plain, pass_rows = [], [], [], [], []
    finals, walks, last_ask_ratio, accepts = [], [], [], []
    for run in runs:
        cid, b = run["case_id"], run["case"]["buyer"]
        r_s = rates.get(cid, r_all)
        for sup, t in run["d"]["threads"].items():
            S = [m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer"]
            B = [m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] == "buyer" and sheets(m)]
            if not S or not sheets(S[0]):
                continue
            sv = [value(*sheets(m)[0], r_s) if sheets(m) else None for m in S]
            bv = [max(value(p, d, r_s) for p, d in sheets(m)) for m in B]
            o = sv[0]
            fin = next((i for i, m in enumerate(S) if m["status"] == "final_offer"), None)
            if fin is not None:
                last_ask_ratio.append(sv[fin] / o)
            finals.append({"run": run["agent"] + "_" + cid, "supplier": sup, "round": fin,
                           "idle_moves_before": sum(1 for i in range(1, min(fin or 0, len(bv))) if bv[i] - bv[i - 1] < 0.002 * o) if fin else None,
                           "buyer_moves_before": min(fin or 0, len(B))})  # fmt: skip
            end = min(fin if fin is not None else len(S) - 1, len(S) - 1)
            dsum = bsum = 0.0
            for i in range(1, end + 1):
                if sv[i] is None or i - 1 >= len(bv):
                    break
                ds = sv[i - 1] - sv[i]
                n_ver = sum(c.get("result") == "verified" for c in (S[i].get("claim_results") or []))
                if i == 1:
                    (step1_claims if n_ver else step1_plain).append((ds / o, n_ver))
                    continue
                db = bv[i - 1] - bv[i - 2] if i >= 2 and i - 1 < len(bv) else 0
                if db < 0.002 * o:
                    idle_steps.append(ds / o)
                else:
                    dsum, bsum = dsum + ds, bsum + db
                pass_rows.append((cid, round(db / o, 4), round(ds / o, 4)))
            if bsum > 0.01 * o:
                g_runs.append(dsum / bsum)
            # walk-away / agreement after final: pushes that did not meet the ask
            if fin is not None:
                pushes = [m for m in B[fin:] if sheets(m)]
                walked = S[-1]["status"] == "walked_away"
                (walks if walked else accepts).append({"run": run["agent"] + "_" + cid, "supplier": sup, "pushes_after_final": len(pushes)})
    P["concession_pass_through"] = param(
        "fitted", len(g_runs), "per thread: sum(supplier ask drop) / sum(our rise in the best offer's value), rounds 2..final, rounds where we moved >0.2% of the opening",
        "range is wide (P02 about 0.02: supplier froze while we moved 10 EUR; P01 about 0.4-0.6); case dependent, not predictable from case fields",
        **spread([round(g, 3) for g in g_runs]), samples=sorted(round(g, 3) for g in g_runs),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["idle_step"] = param(
        "fitted", len(idle_steps), "supplier ask drop per round (share of opening) in rounds where we moved <0.2% of the opening",
        "mostly 0 or tiny; sometimes a small step; samples listed", **spread([round(x, 4) for x in idle_steps]), samples=sorted(round(x, 4) for x in idle_steps),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["first_reply_drop_with_verified_claims"] = param(
        "fitted", len(step1_claims), "first supplier reply drop (share of opening) when it verified >=1 cited fact (evidence_router runs)",
        "tiny sample; supplier text also moves the effective date after a verified notice-period claim (P01)",
        samples=[round(x, 4) for x, _ in step1_claims],
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["first_reply_drop_plain"] = param(
        "fitted", len(step1_plain), "first supplier reply drop (share of opening) with no verified claim",
        "see samples", samples=sorted(round(x, 4) for x, _ in step1_plain),
    )  # fmt: skip
    fr = [f["round"] for f in finals if f["round"] is not None]
    P["final_offer_round"] = param(
        "fitted", len(fr), "reply index of the first final_offer in each supplier thread (30 runs)",
        f"{len(finals) - len(fr)} threads never sent one (agreed at once, or the run ended); depends little on how much we moved; round limit is 10",
        **spread(fr), samples=sorted(fr), threads=finals,
    )  # fmt: skip
    wp = [w["pushes_after_final"] for w in walks]
    P["walk_after_pushes_post_final"] = param(
        "fitted", len(wp), "pushes (our term sheets that did not meet the ask) after final_offer before the supplier walked away",
        "walks: P05 70210 (4), 70250 (1 and 3), P10 (1,1,1). Not walks: P01 2 pushes then price re-quoted for 90 days, P07 1 push matched",
        samples=sorted(wp), walks=walks, no_walk=accepts,
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["final_offer_ask_vs_opening"] = param(
        "fitted", len(last_ask_ratio), "value of the final_offer / opening value (at the standard payment days)",
        "the supplier's frozen position: how far it actually came down in 30 runs", **spread([round(x, 4) for x in last_ask_ratio]),
        samples=sorted(round(x, 4) for x in last_ask_ratio),
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- term trades and hard limits ---------------------------------------------------------
    texts = [(run["case_id"], s, m.get("body") or "") for run in runs for s, t in run["d"]["threads"].items() for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer"]
    limit_threads = {(c, s) for c, s, b in texts if "absolute limit" in b and "30 days" in b}
    all_threads = {(c, s) for c, s, _ in texts}
    cap_threads = {(c, s) for c, s, b in texts if "allocation cap" in b}
    P["payment_days_trade"] = param(
        "fitted", len(rates), "= supplier_interest_rate: a longer payment term costs the buyer about r * days / 360 of the price",
        "pairs fit one rate per case with spread; whether the supplier accepts 90 days at all is the hard limit below",
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["payment_days_hard_limit_30"] = param(
        "fitted", len(all_threads), f"'30 days is our absolute limit / strictly tied to 30 days' said by {sorted(limit_threads)}",
        "2 of 12 threads (17%); the quoted threads are small owner-run shops (rfq P05); the others traded 60/90 days for a higher price",
        share=round(len(limit_threads) / len(all_threads), 3),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["volume_cap"] = param(
        "fitted", len(cap_threads), f"P10 capacity: 'our allocation cap strictly limits the volume to 19,890 pieces per year' (middle of options 16379/19890/23400); {sorted(cap_threads)}",
        "one case; no evidence on whether a premium lifts the cap (the must-have asks >= 22230, the supplier would not move)",
        cap_option_index=1,
    )  # fmt: skip
    asked = []
    con = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{Path(data_dir) / 'world.sqlite'}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    for a, s_ in con.execute("select asked_pct, settled_pct from negotiation_history where asked_pct is not null and settled_pct is not null"):
        if a > 0:
            asked.append(round(s_ / a, 3))
    P["history_settle_share_of_ask"] = param(
        "fitted", len(asked), "world.sqlite negotiation_history: settled_pct / asked_pct for past asks > 0 (share of a price increase the supplier kept)",
        "past real-world events of the fictional firm, not arena sessions; the arena's suppliers may differ; used as a cross-check of the floor, not in the mock",
        **spread(asked), q25=q(asked, 0.25), q75=q(asked, 0.75),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["accept_tolerance"] = param(
        "fitted", 3, "agreed at an offer worth less than its ask: P03 (value -1.1%: 438.21 at 90 vs at 30 days) and P07 (-1% pd); refused P01 (-1.6%) and P05 70210 (30 vs 90 days)",
        "bounds only: tolerance in about [0.011, 0.016) of the ask value; assumed uniform inside", min=0.0, max=0.016,
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["answers_to_questions"] = param(
        "fitted", 7, "supplier questions in the dumps: 'Which volume can you commit to?' (P03,P08,P10, when we have a volume term), "
        "'Which figures is that based on / please send the data' (P01, after an unsupported claim of analysis); 'breakdown' requests answered by cost-breakdown.xlsx",
        "no dump shows a concession after we answer; the mock only asks and ignores the answer (assumed), cited facts that verify earn the first-reply bonus",
    )  # fmt: skip
    for k in ("jitter_between_runs",):
        P[k] = param(
            "assumed", 0, "same case and supplier gave identical openings and the same ask path in different agents' runs (P02: 373.64 in all three)",
            "not tested: whether suppliers are random; seed jitter in the mock is assumed", value=0.01,
        )  # fmt: skip
    return {
        "meta": {"source": "sim_cases/real_runs (30 dumps, 10 cases) + sim_cases/real + data package", "cases": sorted(by_case), "c_open_check": c_open_check},
        "parameters": P,
        "pass_through_rows": pass_rows,
        "opening_rows": opens,
    }


def main(argv=None):

    ap.add_argument("--data", default=str(Path.home() / "Documents/Codex/negotiation-arena-kit/data"))

    a = ap.parse_args(argv)

    for k, v in out["parameters"].items():

"""Fit the real-like supplier from evidence: the 30 real practice dumps (sim_cases/real_runs), the
real case files (sim_cases/real) and the data package. Writes sim_cases/supplier_profile.json.

    python -m arena_kit.fit_supplier [--data <data package>] [--out supplier_profile.json]

Every parameter carries `status` ("fitted" with n samples, or "assumed" with no evidence), the
evidence it comes from and its uncertainty. Nothing is invented: what the dumps cannot show is
marked assumed. Reads local files only; never calls the arena.
"""

import argparse
import glob
import itertools
import json
import re
import sqlite3
import statistics as st
from pathlib import Path

from .cost import must_haves_ok, supplier_value, total_cost

HERE = Path(__file__).parent / "sim_cases"
STD_PD = 30  # every supplier text in the dumps says "our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net"


def sheets(msg):
    """(price, payment_days) of each term sheet of a message; no payment days = the standard 30."""
    return [
        (x["terms"]["unit_price"], x["terms"].get("payment_days") or STD_PD)
        for x in (msg.get("term_sheets") or [])
        if x["terms"].get("unit_price")
    ]


def value(price, pd, r):
    """Cash-equivalent of a price at the standard payment days, for a supplier whose money costs r a year."""
    return price * (1 - r * (pd - STD_PD) / 360)


def q(xs, p):
    xs = sorted(xs)
    return xs[min(len(xs) - 1, int(p * len(xs)))] if xs else None


def spread(xs):
    return {"n": len(xs), "min": min(xs), "median": st.median(xs), "max": max(xs)} if xs else {"n": 0}


def param(status, n, evidence, uncertainty, **vals):
    return {"status": status, "n": n, "evidence": evidence, "uncertainty": uncertainty, **vals}


def load():
    runs = []
    for f in sorted(glob.glob(str(HERE / "real_runs" / "*_P*.json"))):
        d = json.load(open(f))
        case = json.load(open(HERE / "real" / f"{d['case']}.json"))
        runs.append({"agent": d["agent"], "case_id": d["case"], "case": case, "d": d, "r": d["result"]})
    return runs


def pair_rates(msgs):
    """The supplier's cost of money r from messages that quote the same offer at two payment terms."""
    out = []
    for m in msgs:
        s = sheets(m)
        for (p1, d1), (p2, d2) in itertools.combinations(s, 2):
            if d1 != d2 and p1 and p2:
                den = p1 * (d1 - STD_PD) - p2 * (d2 - STD_PD)
                if den and 0 < (r := 360 * (p1 - p2) / den) < 0.5:
                    out.append(r)
    return out


def standard_terms(case, run_results):
    """The supplier's standard terms: non-negotiated fields from any deal on the case, payment 30."""
    std = {}
    for r in run_results:
        if r["terms"]:
            std = {k: v for k, v in r["terms"].items() if k not in case["negotiable"]}
            break
    for f in case["negotiable"][1:]:
        o = case["term_options"].get(f) or [None]
        std[f] = STD_PD if f == "payment_days" else o[0]
    return std


def implied_floor(case, std, r_s, c_best, opening):
    """The supplier's floor V (cash value per unit at its standard terms) that reproduces the arena's
    C_best: bisect V so that the cheapest package it would accept (every lever) costs c_best."""
    sup = {"standard": std, "interest_rate": r_s}
    levers = case["negotiable"][1:]
    combos = [dict(zip(levers, c, strict=True)) for c in itertools.product(*[case["term_options"].get(f) or [None] for f in levers])]
    combos = [c for c in combos if must_haves_ok(case, c, std)]

    def cheapest(v):
        best = float("inf")
        for c in combos:
            a = supplier_value(case, {**c, "unit_price": 0.0}, sup)
            b = supplier_value(case, {**c, "unit_price": 1.0}, sup) - a
            best = min(best, total_cost(case, {**c, "unit_price": (v - a) / b}, std))
        return best

    lo, hi = 0.2 * opening, 1.6 * opening
    if not cheapest(lo) < c_best < cheapest(hi):
        return None
    for _ in range(60):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        lo, hi = (mid, hi) if cheapest(mid) < c_best else (lo, mid)
    return (lo + hi) / 2


def fit(data_dir):
    runs = load()
    by_case = {}
    for r in runs:
        by_case.setdefault(r["case_id"], []).append(r)
    P, table = {}, {}

    # -- supplier cost of money from price pairs at two payment terms --------------------------
    rates = {}
    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
        vals = [x for run in rs for t in run["d"]["threads"].values() for x in pair_rates([m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer"])]
        if vals:
            rates[cid] = st.median(vals)
    r_all = st.median(rates.values())
    P["supplier_interest_rate"] = param(
        "fitted", len(rates),
        "price pairs in one supplier message at two payment terms (e.g. P01: 137.50 at 60 days vs 136.40 at 30)",
        f"per-case values {spread(list(rates.values()))}; the buyer rates in the cases are 0.04-0.12; per case rate not given by the arena",
        per_case={k: round(v, 4) for k, v in rates.items()}, min=round(min(rates.values()), 4),
        median=round(r_all, 4), max=round(max(rates.values()), 4),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["standard_payment_days"] = param(
        "fitted", sum("standard Zahlungsziel is 30" in (m.get("body") or "") for run in runs for t in run["d"]["threads"].values() for m in t["messages"]),
        "the supplier texts say 'our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net' in every case that mentions it",
        "no counter-example in 30 dumps; the suppliers table has payment_days 30/45/60 for others (not used)",
        value=STD_PD,
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- opening price relative to the buyer's current/fallback price --------------------------
    opens, c_open_check = [], {}
    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
        case, b = rs[0]["case"], rs[0]["case"]["buyer"]
        std = standard_terms(case, [x["r"] for x in rs])
        ups = []
        for sup, t in rs[0]["d"]["threads"].items():
            first = next(m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer")
            op = sheets(first)[0][0]
            ref = b.get("current_unit_price") or b["fallback_unit_price"]
            kind = "current" if b.get("current_unit_price") else "fallback"
            opens.append({"case": cid, "type": case["type"], "supplier": sup, "opening": op, "ref": kind,
                          "vs_current": round(op / b["current_unit_price"], 4) if b.get("current_unit_price") else None,
                          "vs_fallback": round(op / b["fallback_unit_price"], 4)})  # fmt: skip
            ups.append(op)
        # the arena's C_open = the cheapest opening quote: does it match our standard-terms recomputation?
        cs = [total_cost(case, {**{f: std[f] for f in case["negotiable"][1:]}, "unit_price": u}, std) for u in ups]
        c_open_check[cid] = {"reported": rs[0]["r"]["c_open"], "recomputed_min": min(cs), "match_pct": round(100 * (min(cs) / rs[0]["r"]["c_open"] - 1), 3)}
    cur = [o["vs_current"] for o in opens if o["vs_current"]]
    types = {}
    for o in opens:
        if o["vs_current"]:
            types.setdefault(o["type"], []).append(o["vs_current"])
    P["opening_vs_current_price"] = param(
        "fitted", len(cur),
        "first supplier quote / the case's current_unit_price, 10 hosted cases, 12 supplier threads",
        "ratio ranges 0.91 (bundling, below current) to 1.13; by case type only 1-2 samples each; P05 (rfq) has no current price",
        by_type={k: spread(v) for k, v in types.items()}, **{k: v for k, v in spread(cur).items() if k != "n"},
        samples=sorted(cur),
    )  # fmt: skip
    fb = [o["vs_fallback"] for o in opens if o["ref"] == "fallback"]
    P["opening_vs_fallback_price_rfq"] = param(
        "fitted", len(fb), "P05 rfq: three suppliers' first quotes / the case's fallback price (no current price in rfq)",
        "one case only", samples=sorted(fb),
    )  # fmt: skip
    ann = []
    for rs in by_case.values():
        m = re.search(r"\+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?) ?%", rs[0]["case"]["title"])
        b = rs[0]["case"]["buyer"]
        if m and b.get("current_unit_price"):
            first = sheets(next(x for x in next(iter(rs[0]["d"]["threads"].values()))["messages"] if x["from"] != "buyer"))[0][0]
            ann.append((float(m[1]), round(100 * (first / b["current_unit_price"] - 1), 2)))
    P["opening_equals_announced_increase"] = param(
        "fitted", len(ann), "case title '+x %' vs opening/current - 1", "P01: +9.5 asked, +9.50 opened; P02: +6.5 vs +6.49; tiny sample",
        pairs=ann,
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- floor implied by the arena's own C_best -------------------------------------------------
    floors, floor_rows = [], {}
    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
        case, res = rs[0]["case"], rs[0]["r"]
        std = standard_terms(case, [x["r"] for x in rs])
        ok = abs(c_open_check[cid]["match_pct"]) < 0.5
        ops = [o["opening"] for o in opens if o["case"] == cid]
        row = {"c_open_matches": ok, "c_best": res["c_best"], "c_open": res["c_open"]}
        if ok and res["c_best"] < (res["c_alt"] or 1e18) - 1:
            r_s = rates.get(cid, r_all)
            lo = implied_floor(case, std, min(r_s, r_all) * 0.7, res["c_best"], min(ops))
            mid = implied_floor(case, std, r_s, res["c_best"], min(ops))
            hi = implied_floor(case, std, max(r_s, r_all) * 1.3, res["c_best"], min(ops))
            row.update(floor_ratio=round(mid / min(ops), 4) if mid else None,
                       floor_ratio_range=[round(x / min(ops), 4) for x in (lo, hi) if x],
                       r_used=round(r_s, 4), rate_fitted=cid in rates)  # fmt: skip
            if mid:
                floors.append(mid / min(ops))
        floor_rows[cid] = row
    P["floor_vs_opening"] = param(
        "fitted", len(floors),
        "the supplier's cheapest accepted package: V such that the cheapest lever package at V costs the arena's C_best (cost.supplier_value, cost.total_cost); ratio V / best opening quote",
        "assumes C_best = supplier_value floor with every lever (brief.md section 6); standard terms rebuilt from the deals; rate varies +-30%; "
        "the floors of P03/P07/P08/P18 lie far below anything a supplier conceded (it froze first), so they bound room, not behaviour",
        per_case=floor_rows, **{k: round(v, 4) for k, v in spread(floors).items() if k != "n"}, samples=sorted(round(f, 4) for f in floors),
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- concession, final offer, walk-away, claims --------------------------------------------
    g_runs, idle_steps, step1_claims, step1_plain, pass_rows = [], [], [], [], []
    finals, walks, last_ask_ratio, accepts = [], [], [], []
    for run in runs:
        cid, b = run["case_id"], run["case"]["buyer"]
        r_s = rates.get(cid, r_all)
        for sup, t in run["d"]["threads"].items():
            S = [m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer"]
            B = [m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] == "buyer" and sheets(m)]
            if not S or not sheets(S[0]):
                continue
            sv = [value(*sheets(m)[0], r_s) if sheets(m) else None for m in S]
            bv = [max(value(p, d, r_s) for p, d in sheets(m)) for m in B]
            o = sv[0]
            fin = next((i for i, m in enumerate(S) if m["status"] == "final_offer"), None)
            if fin is not None:
                last_ask_ratio.append(sv[fin] / o)
            finals.append({"run": run["agent"] + "_" + cid, "supplier": sup, "round": fin,
                           "idle_moves_before": sum(1 for i in range(1, min(fin or 0, len(bv))) if bv[i] - bv[i - 1] < 0.002 * o) if fin else None,
                           "buyer_moves_before": min(fin or 0, len(B))})  # fmt: skip
            end = min(fin if fin is not None else len(S) - 1, len(S) - 1)
            dsum = bsum = 0.0
            for i in range(1, end + 1):
                if sv[i] is None or i - 1 >= len(bv):
                    break
                ds = sv[i - 1] - sv[i]
                n_ver = sum(c.get("result") == "verified" for c in (S[i].get("claim_results") or []))
                if i == 1:
                    (step1_claims if n_ver else step1_plain).append((ds / o, n_ver))
                    continue
                db = bv[i - 1] - bv[i - 2] if i >= 2 and i - 1 < len(bv) else 0
                if db < 0.002 * o:
                    idle_steps.append(ds / o)
                else:
                    dsum, bsum = dsum + ds, bsum + db
                pass_rows.append((cid, round(db / o, 4), round(ds / o, 4)))
            if bsum > 0.01 * o:
                g_runs.append(dsum / bsum)
            # walk-away / agreement after final: pushes that did not meet the ask
            if fin is not None:
                pushes = [m for m in B[fin:] if sheets(m)]
                walked = S[-1]["status"] == "walked_away"
                (walks if walked else accepts).append({"run": run["agent"] + "_" + cid, "supplier": sup, "pushes_after_final": len(pushes)})
    P["concession_pass_through"] = param(
        "fitted", len(g_runs), "per thread: sum(supplier ask drop) / sum(our rise in the best offer's value), rounds 2..final, rounds where we moved >0.2% of the opening",
        "range is wide (P02 about 0.02: supplier froze while we moved 10 EUR; P01 about 0.4-0.6); case dependent, not predictable from case fields",
        **spread([round(g, 3) for g in g_runs]), samples=sorted(round(g, 3) for g in g_runs),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["idle_step"] = param(
        "fitted", len(idle_steps), "supplier ask drop per round (share of opening) in rounds where we moved <0.2% of the opening",
        "mostly 0 or tiny; sometimes a small step; samples listed", **spread([round(x, 4) for x in idle_steps]), samples=sorted(round(x, 4) for x in idle_steps),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["first_reply_drop_with_verified_claims"] = param(
        "fitted", len(step1_claims), "first supplier reply drop (share of opening) when it verified >=1 cited fact (evidence_router runs)",
        "tiny sample; supplier text also moves the effective date after a verified notice-period claim (P01)",
        samples=[round(x, 4) for x, _ in step1_claims],
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["first_reply_drop_plain"] = param(
        "fitted", len(step1_plain), "first supplier reply drop (share of opening) with no verified claim",
        "see samples", samples=sorted(round(x, 4) for x, _ in step1_plain),
    )  # fmt: skip
    fr = [f["round"] for f in finals if f["round"] is not None]
    P["final_offer_round"] = param(
        "fitted", len(fr), "reply index of the first final_offer in each supplier thread (30 runs)",
        f"{len(finals) - len(fr)} threads never sent one (agreed at once, or the run ended); depends little on how much we moved; round limit is 10",
        **spread(fr), samples=sorted(fr), threads=finals,
    )  # fmt: skip
    wp = [w["pushes_after_final"] for w in walks]
    P["walk_after_pushes_post_final"] = param(
        "fitted", len(wp), "pushes (our term sheets that did not meet the ask) after final_offer before the supplier walked away",
        "walks: P05 70210 (4), 70250 (1 and 3), P10 (1,1,1). Not walks: P01 2 pushes then price re-quoted for 90 days, P07 1 push matched",
        samples=sorted(wp), walks=walks, no_walk=accepts,
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["final_offer_ask_vs_opening"] = param(
        "fitted", len(last_ask_ratio), "value of the final_offer / opening value (at the standard payment days)",
        "the supplier's frozen position: how far it actually came down in 30 runs", **spread([round(x, 4) for x in last_ask_ratio]),
        samples=sorted(round(x, 4) for x in last_ask_ratio),
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- term trades and hard limits ---------------------------------------------------------
    texts = [(run["case_id"], s, m.get("body") or "") for run in runs for s, t in run["d"]["threads"].items() for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer"]
    limit_threads = {(c, s) for c, s, b in texts if "absolute limit" in b and "30 days" in b}
    all_threads = {(c, s) for c, s, _ in texts}
    cap_threads = {(c, s) for c, s, b in texts if "allocation cap" in b}
    P["payment_days_trade"] = param(
        "fitted", len(rates), "= supplier_interest_rate: a longer payment term costs the buyer about r * days / 360 of the price",
        "pairs fit one rate per case with spread; whether the supplier accepts 90 days at all is the hard limit below",
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["payment_days_hard_limit_30"] = param(
        "fitted", len(all_threads), f"'30 days is our absolute limit / strictly tied to 30 days' said by {sorted(limit_threads)}",
        "2 of 12 threads (17%); the quoted threads are small owner-run shops (rfq P05); the others traded 60/90 days for a higher price",
        share=round(len(limit_threads) / len(all_threads), 3),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["volume_cap"] = param(
        "fitted", len(cap_threads), f"P10 capacity: 'our allocation cap strictly limits the volume to 19,890 pieces per year' (middle of options 16379/19890/23400); {sorted(cap_threads)}",
        "one case; no evidence on whether a premium lifts the cap (the must-have asks >= 22230, the supplier would not move)",
        cap_option_index=1,
    )  # fmt: skip
    asked = []
    con = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{Path(data_dir) / 'world.sqlite'}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    for a, s_ in con.execute("select asked_pct, settled_pct from negotiation_history where asked_pct is not null and settled_pct is not null"):
        if a > 0:
            asked.append(round(s_ / a, 3))
    P["history_settle_share_of_ask"] = param(
        "fitted", len(asked), "world.sqlite negotiation_history: settled_pct / asked_pct for past asks > 0 (share of a price increase the supplier kept)",
        "past real-world events of the fictional firm, not arena sessions; the arena's suppliers may differ; used as a cross-check of the floor, not in the mock",
        **spread(asked), q25=q(asked, 0.25), q75=q(asked, 0.75),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["accept_tolerance"] = param(
        "fitted", 3, "agreed at an offer worth less than its ask: P03 (value -1.1%: 438.21 at 90 vs at 30 days) and P07 (-1% pd); refused P01 (-1.6%) and P05 70210 (30 vs 90 days)",
        "bounds only: tolerance in about [0.011, 0.016) of the ask value; assumed uniform inside", min=0.0, max=0.016,
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["answers_to_questions"] = param(
        "fitted", 7, "supplier questions in the dumps: 'Which volume can you commit to?' (P03,P08,P10, when we have a volume term), "
        "'Which figures is that based on / please send the data' (P01, after an unsupported claim of analysis); 'breakdown' requests answered by cost-breakdown.xlsx",
        "no dump shows a concession after we answer; the mock only asks and ignores the answer (assumed), cited facts that verify earn the first-reply bonus",
    )  # fmt: skip
    for k in ("jitter_between_runs",):
        P[k] = param(
            "assumed", 0, "same case and supplier gave identical openings and the same ask path in different agents' runs (P02: 373.64 in all three)",
            "not tested: whether suppliers are random; seed jitter in the mock is assumed", value=0.01,
        )  # fmt: skip
    return {
        "meta": {"source": "sim_cases/real_runs (30 dumps, 10 cases) + sim_cases/real + data package", "cases": sorted(by_case), "c_open_check": c_open_check},
        "parameters": P,
        "pass_through_rows": pass_rows,
        "opening_rows": opens,
    }


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("--data", default=str(Path.home() / "Documents/Codex/negotiation-arena-kit/data"))
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=str(HERE / "supplier_profile.json"))
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    out = fit(a.data)
    Path(a.out).write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    for k, v in out["parameters"].items():
        print(f"{k:42} {v['status']:8} n={v['n']:<3}", {x: v[x] for x in ("min", "median", "max", "value") if x in v})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
