"""Play cases with an agent against the arena over HTTP - the hosted arena (practice, sandbox,
final) or `arena-sim`, the local contract simulator. Both speak the same API.

An agent is any object with `decide(case, threads) -> {"supplier_id": ..., "message": {...}}`:
  threads: {supplier_id: [message, ...]} - every e-mail so far, both directions, in order;
           supplier attachments carry their text under "text" (see `docs.read_document`).
  message: subject, body, up to 3 term sheets, refs - or an "action" that closes the case:
           {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": ...} or {"type": "walk_away"}.
"""

import functools
import logging
import re
import threading
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

from .client import ArenaError
from .cost import must_haves_ok, total_cost
from .docs import read_document, standard_terms

log = logging.getLogger("arena")

ENDED = {"walked_away", "no_bid"}
# A message later than this after the supplier's last one counts as a timeout.
MOVE_LIMIT_S = 60
# In the Live Final, close this long before the wave's cap - or the slowest round of the case so far
# (your decision plus a supplier reply of up to about a minute) plus a margin, if that is longer.
CLOSE_BEFORE_CAP_S, ROUND_MARGIN_S = 90, 15
RUNNING = re.compile(r"one session per case in the final: (\S+)")
# Practice: the case list shows every practice case file; only those marked hosted can be played
# (a session on another is a 403). Without the marker every listed case counts as hosted.
HOSTED_FIELD = "hosted"


class RemoteTable:
    """The arena over HTTP: the practice arena, the final, or a hosted sandbox."""

    def __init__(self, client, case=None):
        self.client, self.session_id, self.case, self.done = client, None, case, None

    def open(self, case_id):
        try:
            r = self.client.open_session(case_id)
        except ArenaError as e:
            running = RUNNING.search(str(e.detail)) if e.status == 409 else None
            if not (running and self.case):
                raise
            return self.resume(running.group(1))
        self.session_id = r["session_id"]
        log.info("session %s", self.session_id)
        return r["case"], r["threads"]

    def resume(self, session_id):
        """Pick up a final session this team already started (e.g. after a crash): every thread
        so far, from the arena."""
        self.session_id = session_id
        log.info("resuming session %s", session_id)
        state = self.client.session(session_id)
        if state["status"] == "ended":
            self.done = self.result()
        return self.case, {s: self.client.thread(session_id, s)["messages"] for s in state["threads"]}

    def send(self, supplier_id, message):
        return self.client.send_message(self.session_id, supplier_id, message)

    def close(self, supplier_id, message):
        reply = self.client.send_message(self.session_id, supplier_id, message)
        return reply.get("result", reply)  # the supplier's last e-mail carries the result

    def attachment(self, attachment_id):
        return self.client.attachment(self.session_id, attachment_id)

    def missed(self, supplier_id, error):
        """After a 409: the result if the case has ended (e.g. at a wave's cap), else what the
        thread now says (a timeout answer, or the reason it ended)."""
        state = self.client.session(self.session_id)
        if state.get("status") == "ended":
            return {"result": state.get("result") or {"deal": False, "end_reason": state.get("end_reason")}}
        t = self.client.thread(self.session_id, supplier_id)

typing_extensions.py
"""Play cases with an agent against the arena over HTTP - the hosted arena (practice, sandbox,
final) or `arena-sim`, the local contract simulator. Both speak the same API.

An agent is any object with `decide(case, threads) -> {"supplier_id": ..., "message": {...}}`:
  threads: {supplier_id: [message, ...]} - every e-mail so far, both directions, in order;
           supplier attachments carry their text under "text" (see `docs.read_document`).
  message: subject, body, up to 3 term sheets, refs - or an "action" that closes the case:
           {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": ...} or {"type": "walk_away"}.
"""

import functools
import logging
import re
import threading
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

from .client import ArenaError
from .cost import must_haves_ok, total_cost
from .docs import read_document, standard_terms

log = logging.getLogger("arena")

ENDED = {"walked_away", "no_bid"}
# A message later than this after the supplier's last one counts as a timeout.
MOVE_LIMIT_S = 60
# In the Live Final, close this long before the wave's cap - or the slowest round of the case so far
# (your decision plus a supplier reply of up to about a minute) plus a margin, if that is longer.
CLOSE_BEFORE_CAP_S, ROUND_MARGIN_S = 90, 15
RUNNING = re.compile(r"one session per case in the final: (\S+)")
# Practice: the case list shows every practice case file; only those marked hosted can be played
# (a session on another is a 403). Without the marker every listed case counts as hosted.
HOSTED_FIELD = "hosted"


class RemoteTable:
    """The arena over HTTP: the practice arena, the final, or a hosted sandbox."""

    def __init__(self, client, case=None):
        self.client, self.session_id, self.case, self.done = client, None, case, None

    def open(self, case_id):
        try:
            r = self.client.open_session(case_id)
        except ArenaError as e:
            running = RUNNING.search(str(e.detail)) if e.status == 409 else None
            if not (running and self.case):
                raise
            return self.resume(running.group(1))
        self.session_id = r["session_id"]
        log.info("session %s", self.session_id)
        return r["case"], r["threads"]

    def resume(self, session_id):
        """Pick up a final session this team already started (e.g. after a crash): every thread
        so far, from the arena."""
        self.session_id = session_id
        log.info("resuming session %s", session_id)
        state = self.client.session(session_id)
        if state["status"] == "ended":
            self.done = self.result()
        return self.case, {s: self.client.thread(session_id, s)["messages"] for s in state["threads"]}

    def send(self, supplier_id, message):
        return self.client.send_message(self.session_id, supplier_id, message)

    def close(self, supplier_id, message):
        reply = self.client.send_message(self.session_id, supplier_id, message)
        return reply.get("result", reply)  # the supplier's last e-mail carries the result

    def attachment(self, attachment_id):
        return self.client.attachment(self.session_id, attachment_id)

    def missed(self, supplier_id, error):
        """After a 409: the result if the case has ended (e.g. at a wave's cap), else what the
        thread now says (a timeout answer, or the reason it ended)."""
        state = self.client.session(self.session_id)
        if state.get("status") == "ended":
            return {"result": state.get("result") or {"deal": False, "end_reason": state.get("end_reason")}}
        t = self.client.thread(self.session_id, supplier_id)

def package_cost(case, std, rate, floor, pd_limit=None, vol_cap=None):
    """C of the cheapest package a supplier accepts: over every allowed value of the other terms, the
    price at which it receives exactly `floor` (cash per unit at its standard terms). inf if none."""
    names = levers(case)
    sup = {"standard": std, "interest_rate": rate}
    best = float("inf")
    for combo in itertools.product(*[case["term_options"].get(f) or [None] for f in names]):
        c = dict(zip(names, combo, strict=True))
        if (pd_limit and (c.get("payment_days") or 0) > pd_limit) or (vol_cap and (c.get("volume_per_year") or 0) > vol_cap):
            continue
        if not must_haves_ok(case, c, std):
            continue
        a = supplier_value(case, {**c, "unit_price": 0.0}, sup)
        b = supplier_value(case, {**c, "unit_price": 1.0}, sup) - a
        best = min(best, total_cost(case, {**c, "unit_price": (floor - a) / b}, std))
    return best

content.content:
"""Read-only access to the data package: SQL, lookup by citable ID, documents, practice cases -
plus the Sunday release (new news, letters and a memo) once you have downloaded it."""

import csv
import json
import os
import sqlite3
from functools import cached_property
from pathlib import Path

MAX_ROWS = 200
RELEASE = "release-sunday"


class DataPackage:
    def __init__(self, root, release=None):
        """`root`: the unpacked package. `release`: the unpacked Sunday release (default: a
        `release-sunday` folder inside or next to the package, or ARENA_RELEASE), if present."""
        self.root = Path(root).expanduser().resolve()
        # facts.json holds every citable fact with the fields the arena checks claims against.
        own = self.root / "facts.json"
        facts = [own] if own.is_file() else [p for p in sorted(self.root.rglob("facts.json")) if RELEASE not in p.parts]
        self.facts = json.loads(facts[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if facts else {}
        release = release or os.environ.get("ARENA_RELEASE")
        candidates = [Path(release).expanduser()] if release else [self.root / RELEASE, self.root.parent / RELEASE]
        self.release = next((p.resolve() for p in candidates if (p / "facts.json").is_file()), None)
        if self.release:  # new IDs only: nothing in the package changes
            self.facts |= json.loads((self.release / "facts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        dbs = sorted(self.root.rglob("*.sqlite")) + sorted(self.root.rglob("*.db"))
        if not dbs and not facts:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"no facts.json or .sqlite under {self.root}")
        self.db = None
        if dbs:
            self.db = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{dbs[0]}?mode=ro", uri=True, check_same_thread=False)
            self.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            self.db.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")

    def tables(self):
        """{table: {"columns": [...], "rows": n}}"""
        if self.db is None:
            return {}
        names = [r[0] for r in self.db.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' ORDER BY name")]
        return {
            t: {
                "columns": [f"{c[1]} {c[2]}".strip() for c in self.db.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info("{t}")')],
                "rows": self.db.execute(f'SELECT count(*) FROM "{t}"').fetchone()[0],
            }
            for t in names
        }

    def query(self, sql, params=(), limit=MAX_ROWS):
        if self.db is None:
            raise ValueError("this package has no SQLite file")
        if sql.lstrip().split(None, 1)[0].lower() not in {"select", "with"}:
            raise ValueError("read-only: SELECT or WITH statements only")
        cur = self.db.execute(sql, params)
        return [dict(r) for r in cur.fetchmany(limit)]

    @cached_property
    def _ids(self):
        # A table's citable ID sits in its `id` column, else in its first column.
        index = {}

import csv

from pathlib import Path

MAX_ROWS = 200
RELEASE = "release-sunday"


class DataPackage:
    def __init__(self, root, release=None):
        """`root`: the unpacked package. `release`: the unpacked Sunday release (default: a
        `release-sunday` folder inside or next to the package, or ARENA_RELEASE), if present."""
        self.root = Path(root).expanduser().resolve()
        # facts.json holds every citable fact with the fields the arena checks claims against.
        own = self.root / "facts.json"
        facts = [own] if own.is_file() else [p for p in sorted(self.root.rglob("facts.json")) if RELEASE not in p.parts]
        self.facts = json.loads(facts[0].read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if facts else {}
        release = release or os.environ.get("ARENA_RELEASE")
        candidates = [Path(release).expanduser()] if release else [self.root / RELEASE, self.root.parent / RELEASE]
        self.release = next((p.resolve() for p in candidates if (p / "facts.json").is_file()), None)
        if self.release:  # new IDs only: nothing in the package changes
            self.facts |= json.loads((self.release / "facts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        dbs = sorted(self.root.rglob("*.sqlite")) + sorted(self.root.rglob("*.db"))
        if not dbs and not facts:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"no facts.json or .sqlite under {self.root}")
        self.db = None
        if dbs:
            self.db = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{dbs[0]}?mode=ro", uri=True, check_same_thread=False)
            self.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            self.db.execute("PRAGMA query_only = ON")

        names = [r[0] for r in self.db.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' ORDER BY name")]
        return {
            t: {
                "columns": [f"{c[1]} {c[2]}".strip() for c in self.db.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info("{t}")')],
                "rows": self.db.execute(f'SELECT count(*) FROM "{t}"').fetchone()[0],

        return index

# Price adjustment from 01 November 2026

letter - 2026-09-11 - Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Dear Sir or Madam,

we have supplied Hollerau Pumpenwerke reliably for many years. Owing to sustained increases in energy, raw material and wage costs, we are forced to adjust our prices for Volute casing HN 50-200 (part:310010) by **9.5 %** with effect from **01 November 2026**: from EUR 126.53 to EUR 138.55 per  pc.

We regret this step and ask for your understanding.

Yours faithfully,
Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

"""Score agents against the real-like local arena: every case x seed, no API, no credits.

    python -m arena_kit.evaluate --agents guarded_rational,confident_router --set dev --seeds 5

--set dev|test: the generated cases (gen_cases.py; tune on dev, score on test once); real: the 10 hosted
real practice cases, plus a comparison with the scores the same agents really got (sim_cases/real_runs).
It starts arena-sim itself on a free local port (one server per seed, the suppliers' draws follow the seed),
plays with the kit's own client and agents, and stops the servers at the end. It refuses a non-local
ARENA_URL and the `llm` agent (it would call a model API). Reads local files only.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import socket
import statistics as st
import threading
import time
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse

from .cli import AGENTS, agent_factory
from .client import ArenaClient
from .play import RemoteTable, hosted, play_all
from .sim import CASES, load_cases
from .sim_real import SimReal

LOCAL = {"127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"}
DEFAULT_DATA = Path.home() / "Documents/Codex/negotiation-arena-kit/data"


def check_local():
    url = os.environ.get("ARENA_URL")
    if url and urlparse(url).hostname not in LOCAL:
        raise SystemExit(f"refusing to run: ARENA_URL={url} is not local; evaluate only talks to its own simulator")


class Server:
    """arena-sim with the real-like supplier, on a free local port, in a thread."""

    def __init__(self, sim):
        import uvicorn

        from .sim import create_app

        with socket.socket() as s:
            s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
            self.port = s.getsockname()[1]
        self.server = uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(create_app(sim), host="127.0.0.1", port=self.port, log_level="error"))
        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.run, daemon=True)

    def __enter__(self):
        self.thread.start()
        for _ in range(200):
            if self.server.started:
                return f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}"
            time.sleep(0.05)
        raise RuntimeError("the simulator did not start")

    def __exit__(self, *exc):
        self.server.should_exit = True
        self.thread.join(10)


def case_folder(which):
    return {"dev": CASES / "gen_dev", "test": CASES / "gen_test", "real": CASES / "real"}[which]


def play_set(agents, which, seeds, data, parallel):
    """{agent: {(case_id, seed): result or None}}"""
    cases = load_cases(case_folder(which))
    ids = [c["case_id"] for c in hosted(list(cases.values()))]
    facts = {}
    if data and (Path(data) / "facts.json").is_file():
        from .data import DataPackage

        facts = DataPackage(data).facts
    out = {a: {} for a in agents}
    for seed in range(seeds):
        sim = SimReal(cases, facts, "sim", no_clock=True, seed=seed)  # no 60 s rule: agents here are fast
        with Server(sim) as url:
            for name in agents:
                key = ArenaClient(url).register(f"{name}-{seed}", "sim")["api_key"]
                client = ArenaClient(url, key, rate=1000)
                done = play_all(lambda: RemoteTable(client), ids, agent_factory(name, data), parallel)
                for cid, r in done.items():
                    out[name][(cid, seed)] = r.get("score") if isinstance(r, dict) else None
                    if not isinstance(r, dict):
                        print(f"  {name} {cid} seed {seed}: {r!r}")
    return cases, out


def mean(xs):
    return st.mean(xs) if xs else float("nan")


def report(cases, scores):
    print(f"\n{'agent':20} {'mean':>6} {'deal>0':>7} {'worst case (mean over seeds)':>34}")
    for a, res in scores.items():
        per_case = defaultdict(list)
        for (cid, _), v in res.items():
            per_case[cid].append(v or 0.0)
        worst = min(per_case, key=lambda c: mean(per_case[c]))
        allv = [v or 0.0 for v in res.values()]
        print(f"{a:20} {mean(allv):6.3f} {mean([v > 0 for v in allv]):7.2f} {worst:>22} {mean(per_case[worst]):6.3f}")
    types = sorted({c["type"] for c in cases.values()})
    print(f"\n{'mean score by case type':24}" + "".join(f"{a[:14]:>16}" for a in scores))
    for t in types:
        row = []
        for res in scores.values():
            row.append(mean([v or 0.0 for (cid, _), v in res.items() if cases[cid]["type"] == t]))
        print(f"{t:24}" + "".join(f"{x:16.3f}" for x in row))


def real_scores():
    """The scores the agents really got on the practice arena: {(agent, 'case:Pxx'): score}."""
    out = {}
    for f in sorted((CASES / "real_runs").glob("*_P*.json")):
        d = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        out[(d["agent"], f"case:{d['case']}")] = d["result"]["score"]
    return out


def compare(cases, scores):
    real = real_scores()
    agents = [a for a in scores if any(k[0] == a for k in real)]
    rows = []
    for a in agents:
        for cid in sorted({c for (x, c) in real if x == a}):
            m = mean([v or 0.0 for (c, _), v in scores[a].items() if c == cid])
            rows.append((a, cid, real[(a, cid)], m))
    print("\nMOCK vs REAL (the same agents, the same 10 hosted cases)")
    print(f"{'agent':20} {'real mean':>9} {'mock mean':>9}")
    for a in agents:
        r = [x[2] for x in rows if x[0] == a]
        m = [x[3] for x in rows if x[0] == a]
        print(f"{a:20} {mean(r):9.3f} {mean(m):9.3f}")
    if len(rows) > 2:
        print(f"correlation over {len(rows)} (agent, case) pairs: {st.correlation([x[2] for x in rows], [x[3] for x in rows]):.2f}")
        by_case = defaultdict(list)
        for a, cid, r, m in rows:
            by_case[cid].append((r, m))
        cm = {c: (mean([r for r, _ in v]), mean([m for _, m in v])) for c, v in by_case.items()}
        if len(cm) > 2:
            print(f"correlation over {len(cm)} case means (does the mock find the same cases hard?): "
                  f"{st.correlation([v[0] for v in cm.values()], [v[1] for v in cm.values()]):.2f}")  # fmt: skip
    print("biggest mismatches (agent, case, real, mock):")
    for a, cid, r, m in sorted(rows, key=lambda x: -abs(x[2] - x[3]))[:8]:
        print(f"  {a:20} {cid:10} {r:6.3f} {m:6.3f}")


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("--agents", default="guarded_rational,confident_router")
    ap.add_argument("--set", choices=["dev", "test", "real"], default="dev")
    ap.add_argument("--seeds", type=int, default=5)
    ap.add_argument("--data", default=os.environ.get("ARENA_DATA") or str(DEFAULT_DATA))
    ap.add_argument("--parallel", type=int, default=8)
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    check_local()
    agents = a.agents.split(",")
    bad = [x for x in agents if x not in AGENTS or x == "llm"]
    if bad:
        raise SystemExit(f"unknown or not allowed (llm calls a model API): {bad}; choose from {[x for x in AGENTS if x != 'llm']}")
    cases, scores = play_set(agents, a.set, a.seeds, a.data, a.parallel)
    report({k: v for k, v in cases.items() if v.get("hosted", True)}, scores)
    if a.set == "real":
        compare(cases, scores)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""The real-like supplier (sim_real), its fitted profile, the case generator and the evaluator's guards."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from arena_kit import evaluate, gen_cases
from arena_kit.cost import score, total_cost
from arena_kit.sim import CASES, load_cases
from arena_kit.sim_real import PROFILE, SimReal, draw, load_profile, package_cost

SUP = "sup:70110"
P01 = load_cases(CASES / "real")["case:P01"]
DATA = Path.home() / "Documents/Codex/negotiation-arena-kit/data"
needs_data = pytest.mark.skipif(not (DATA / "world.sqlite").is_file(), reason="data package not on this machine")


def offer(price, pd=60):
    return {"term_sheets": [{"terms": {"unit_price": price, "effective_date": "2026-11-01", "payment_days": pd}}], "body": ""}


def session(seed=1, **force):
    sim = SimReal({P01["case_id"]: P01}, no_clock=True, seed=seed)
    sim.teams["k"] = "t"
    sid = sim.open("k", P01["case_id"])["session_id"]
    th = sim.sessions[sid]["threads"][SUP]
    th["p"].update(force)
    return sim, sid, th


def test_profile_marks_every_parameter_fitted_or_assumed():
    params = load_profile()
    assert params and PROFILE.name == "supplier_profile.json"
    for name, p in params.items():
        assert p["status"] in ("fitted", "assumed"), name
        assert isinstance(p["n"], int) and p["evidence"] and p["uncertainty"], name
        assert p["status"] == "assumed" or p["n"] > 0, name


def test_same_seed_same_supplier_other_seed_other_supplier():
    prof = load_profile()
    a, b = draw(prof, P01, SUP, 0, 1, 3), draw(prof, P01, SUP, 0, 1, 3)
    assert a == b and a != draw(prof, P01, SUP, 0, 1, 4)
    opened = [session(seed)[2]["opening"] for seed in (3, 3, 4)]
    assert opened[0] == opened[1] == 138.55  # P01 opens at its announced +9.5 %, whatever the seed
    assert session(3)[2]["floor"] == session(3)[2]["floor"] != session(4)[2]["floor"]


def test_floor_makes_c_best_computable_and_reachable():
    sim, sid, th = session()
    c_open, c_best = sim._bounds(P01, sim.sessions[sid]["threads"])
    assert c_best < c_open
    # the cheapest package at the floor really costs C_best (or the alternative does)
    pk = package_cost(P01, th["standard"], th["p"]["r"], th["floor"], th["p"]["pd_limit"], th["p"]["vol_cap"])
    assert c_best == min(pk, total_cost(P01, P01["buyer"]["alternative"]["terms"]))
    assert score(c_open, c_best, c_best) == 1.0 and score(c_open, c_open, c_best) == 0.0
    # a lower floor leaves more room (C_best falls), a floor at the opening leaves none of the supplier's side
    th["floor"] = round(th["opening"] * 0.8, 2)
    assert sim._bounds(P01, sim.sessions[sid]["threads"])[1] < c_best


def test_agrees_to_a_sheet_worth_its_ask_and_the_deal_scores():
    sim, sid, th = session()
    reply = sim.message("k", sid, SUP, offer(th["opening"], 30))
    assert reply["status"] == "agreed"
    done = sim.message("k", sid, SUP, {"action": {"type": "accept", "term_sheet_id": reply["term_sheets"][0]["term_sheet_id"]}})

content.text:
Sir, the real-like mock arena is built and runs end to end with zero API use. The full suite passes: 269 passed, 2 skipped. On the 10 hosted cases the mock tracks the real scores well (correlation 0.88), but that check is in-sample.

**Environment change:** I installed `fastapi` and `uvicorn` into `~/.venvs/arena-agent` (the declared `sim` extra). The 17 `tests/test_sim.py` tests used to skip without them. They now run and pass.

## Files
- **New:**
  - `agent/arena_kit/fit_supplier.py`, `sim_real.py`, `gen_cases.py`, `evaluate.py`
  - `agent/arena_kit/sim_cases/supplier_profile.json`, `sim_cases/README.md`
  - `agent/arena_kit/sim_cases/gen_dev/` and `gen_test/` (30 cases each)
  - `agent/tests/test_sim_real.py` (10 tests)
- **Changed:** `agent/arena_kit/sim.py`, as small hooks (`_opening`, `_standard`, `_init_thread`, `_bounds`, `_claims`), `--supplier real --seed N --cases DIR`, `load_cases` skipping JSON without a `case_id`, and an overridable `max_calls` rate limit. The old script is the default and its behaviour is unchanged.
- Run the server with the installed `arena-sim` script. `python -m arena_kit.sim` does nothing because the file has no main guard.

## Fitted parameters
The profile now covers 40 dumps: the 30 plus 10 new `reciprocal_evidence` dumps that appeared in `real_runs/`.

| Parameter | Fitted | n | Uncertainty |
|---|---|---|---|
| Supplier cost of money | 0.066–0.098 a year, median 0.074 | 5 cases | The buyer's rate is 0.08. It is read from price pairs at two payment terms. |
| Standard payment term | 30 days | 21 mentions | No counter-example. |
| Opening price / current price | 0.87–1.13 | 12 threads | By type: price_increase 1.065–1.095, renewal 1.06–1.13. Bundling opens below current (0.91, n=1). |
| Price_increase opening | Exactly the announced price | 2 | P01 and P02 only. |
| Floor / opening, from C_best | 0.77–0.98 | 9 cases | Varies by type. Assumes C_best is the supplier's cash floor with every lever applied. A ±30% change in its rate moves the floor by about 0.004. P05 could not be fitted. |
| Concession pass-through | 0–0.7, median 0.37 | 14 runs | One outlier at 1.75. |
| Idle step | Mostly 0 | 39 | |
| First-reply drop | About 1% for a single supplier; much larger when several compete | 18 / 7 | |
| First final_offer round | 2–7, median 4 | 35 threads | A trait of the supplier, not of how much we moved. |
| Walk-away | After 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 3 or 4 pushes past a final offer | 7 | |
| Accept tolerance | 0–1.6% of the ask | 3 | Bounds only. |
| Payment-days hard limit (30) | 1 of 12 threads | 12 | P05 sup:70210. |
| Volume cap (capacity) | Cap at 19,890, lifted by a 24-month contract | 1 | P10 only. |
| Terms the quote leaves out | Payment days omitted 4 of 10, lead time 2 of 4 | 12 | |

Every parameter in the JSON carries its status, n, evidence text and uncertainty. The mock also reproduces C_open in 9 of 10 real cases (P05, an RFQ with three suppliers, does not).

## Mock vs real (10 hosted cases, 10 seeds)

| Agent | Real mean | Mock mean |
|---|---|---|
| `guarded_rational` | 0.179 | 0.219 |
| `confident_router` | 0.286 | 0.309 |
| `evidence_router` | 0.266 | 0.292 |
| `reciprocal_evidence` | 0.570 | 0.524 |

- Correlation is 0.88 over 40 (agent, case) pairs and 0.88 over the 10 case means. The ranking matches (`reciprocal_evidence` first).
- This is an in-sample check: the profile was fitted on these same dumps, so it is not validation.
- Biggest mismatches:
  - The mock is too generous on P02 (`reciprocal_evidence` real 0.18 vs mock 0.57; `confident_router` real 0.30 vs mock 0.57). The real supplier froze completely.
  - The mock is too low on P01 (`evidence_router` real 0.94 vs mock 0.62; `reciprocal_evidence` real 0.90 vs mock 0.59).
  - On P05 `evidence_router` scored 0 in reality and 0.28 in the mock.
  - `reciprocal_evidence` is lower in the mock on P08 and P18.

## Generated sets
- Dev (`gen_dev`) and test (`gen_test`) use disjoint parts.
- Baseline means over 5 seeds:

| Agent | Dev | Test |
|---|---|---|
| `naive` | 0.30 | 0.28 |
| `guarded_rational` | 0.28 | 0.28 |
| `confident_router` | 0.29 | 0.34 |
| `evidence_router` | 0.30 | 0.32 |
| `reciprocal_evidence` | 0.48 | 0.53 |

- I scored the test set once as a baseline. Treat it as spent.

## Not fitted, or assumed
- Whether suppliers are random across runs. The mock draws from fitted ranges per seed, case and supplier.
- Contract-length and volume levers are accepted at no price change. Evidence is P03 and P10 only.
- An overpaying sheet is agreed at the buyer's price. No example exists.
- The standard lead time is the slowest option, and standard ppm is 2.5× the loosest option.
- A ±0.03 range stands in for types with one sample.
- Answers to supplier questions are text only.
- Interest rate 0.04–0.12 and a 3-year horizon in generated cases are variations; the real cases show 0.08 and 1–2 years.
- Only 55 free supplier/part pairs exist, so pairs repeat across cases.
- Generated cases keep a real alternative quote only if one exists for the part, so the test set has few.

## Risks

1	"""A real-like supplier for arena-sim: every number is drawn per seed from sim_cases/supplier_profile.json
2	(fitted by fit_supplier.py from the real practice dumps; what could not be fitted is marked assumed there).
3	
4	    arena-sim serve --supplier real --seed 7
5	
6	How it behaves (one draw per seed, case and supplier, so the same seed replays the same supplier):
7	- opens at a fitted multiple of the buyer's current price (at the announced price in price_increase cases),
8	  quoting at its standard terms (30 days payment);
9	- its ask is a cash value per unit; every sheet is valued with cost.supplier_value at its own money cost;
10	- it agrees to a sheet worth at least its ask minus a small tolerance;
11	- otherwise it concedes: a first-reply drop, then a share (pass-through) of how much our offer rose, a small
12	  step when we idle; it freezes into a final_offer at its drawn round; pushing past it walks away;
13	- some suppliers refuse payment terms beyond 30 days; a capacity supplier caps the volume unless the contract is 24 months or longer;
14	- its floor (never below) fixes C_best: the cheapest package at which it still gets its floor value.
15	"""
16	
17	import itertools
18	import json
19	import random
20	import re
21	from pathlib import Path
22	
23	from .cost import must_haves_ok, supplier_value, total_cost
24	from .sim import Sim, structured
25	
26	PROFILE = Path(__file__).parent / "sim_cases" / "supplier_profile.json"
27	STD_PD = 30
28	
29	
30	def levers(case):
31	    """The negotiable fields other than the price (it is not always listed first, e.g. P11)."""
32	    return [f for f in case["negotiable"] if f != "unit_price"]
33	
34	
35	def load_profile(path=PROFILE):
36	    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["parameters"]
37	
38	
39	LIFT_MONTHS = 24  # a volume cap is lifted by a contract of at least this many months (P10, reciprocal_evidence)
40	
41	
42	def capped(cap, terms):
43	    """True if the volume is over the supplier's allocation cap and the contract is too short to lift it."""
44	    return bool(cap and (terms.get("volume_per_year") or 0) > cap and (terms.get("contract_months") or 0) < LIFT_MONTHS)
45	
46	
47	def package_cost(case, std, rate, floor, pd_limit=None, vol_cap=None):
48	    """C of the cheapest package a supplier accepts: over every allowed value of the other terms, the
49	    price at which it receives exactly `floor` (cash per unit at its standard terms). inf if none."""
50	    names = levers(case)
51	    sup = {"standard": std, "interest_rate": rate}
52	    best = float("inf")
53	    for combo in itertools.product(*[case["term_options"].get(f) or [None] for f in names]):
54	        c = dict(zip(names, combo, strict=True))
55	        if (pd_limit and (c.get("payment_days") or 0) > pd_limit) or capped(vol_cap, c):
56	            continue
57	        if not must_haves_ok(case, c, std):
58	            continue
59	        a = supplier_value(case, {**c, "unit_price": 0.0}, sup)
60	        b = supplier_value(case, {**c, "unit_price": 1.0}, sup) - a
61	        best = min(best, total_cost(case, {**c, "unit_price": (floor - a) / b}, std))
62	    return best
63	
64	
65	def draw(profile, case, sup, i, nsup, seed):
66	    """One supplier's parameters from the fitted ranges. Deterministic in (seed, case, supplier)."""
67	    rng = random.Random(f"{seed}|{case['case_id']}|{sup}")
68	    P = profile
69	    kind = P["opening_vs_current_price"]["by_type"].get(case["type"], {})
70	    lo, hi = (kind["min"], kind["max"]) if kind.get("n", 0) >= 2 else (  # one sample: +-0.03 (assumed width)
71	        (kind["median"] - 0.03, kind["median"] + 0.03) if kind else P["opening_vs_current_price"]["pooled_excl_rfq"]
72	    )  # fmt: skip
73	    ratio = rng.uniform(lo, hi)
74	    f = P["floor_vs_opening"]
75	    fk = f["by_type"].get(case["type"], {})
76	    flo, fhi = (fk["min"], fk["max"]) if fk.get("n", 0) >= 2 else (  # one sample: +-0.03 (assumed width)
77	        (fk["median"] - 0.03, fk["median"] + 0.03) if fk else (f["min"], f["max"])
78	    )  # fmt: skip
79	    caps = case["term_options"].get("volume_per_year") or []
80	    cap = (
81	        sorted(caps)[1]
82	        if case["type"] == "capacity" and len(caps) >= 2 and "volume_per_year" in case["negotiable"]
83	        else None
84	    )
85	    r = P["supplier_interest_rate"]
86	    drops = P["first_reply_drop_multi_supplier" if nsup > 1 else "first_reply_drop_plain"]["samples"]
87	    verified = P["first_reply_drop_with_verified_claims"]["samples"]
88	    return {
89	        "ratio": ratio,
90	        "r": rng.uniform(r["min"], r["max"]),
91	        "floor": min(0.995, rng.uniform(flo, fhi)),
92	        "g": min(1.0, max(0.0, rng.choice(P["concession_pass_through"]["samples"]))) * rng.uniform(0.85, 1.15),
93	        "idle": rng.choice(P["idle_step"]["samples"]),
94	        "first": max(0.0, rng.choice(drops)),
95	        "first_verified": max(0.0, rng.choice(verified)),
96	        "final_round": rng.choice(P["final_offer_round"]["samples"]),
97	        "walk_after": rng.choice(P["walk_after_pushes_post_final"]["samples"]),
98	        "tol": rng.uniform(P["accept_tolerance"]["min"], P["accept_tolerance"]["max"]),
99	        "pd_limit": STD_PD if rng.random() < P["payment_days_hard_limit_30"]["share"] else None,
100	        "vol_cap": cap,
101	        "omit": {f for f, x in P["opening_omits_field"]["rates"].items() if rng.random() < x["omit"]},
102	    }
103	
104	
105	class SimReal(Sim):
106	    def __init__(self, *args, seed=0, profile=None, **kw):
107	        super().__init__(*args, **kw)
108	        self.seed, self.profile, self._p = seed, profile or load_profile(), {}
109	
110	    # -- hooks of Sim --------------------------------------------------------------------------
111	    def _params(self, case, sup, i):
112	        key = (case["case_id"], sup)
113	        if key not in self._p:
114	            self._p[key] = draw(self.profile, case, sup, i, len(case["suppliers"]), self.seed)
115	        return self._p[key]
116	
117	    def _opening(self, case, i, sup, current):
118	        ref = current or case["buyer"]["fallback_unit_price"]
119	        if (
120	            case["type"] == "price_increase" and current
121	        ):  # the supplier opens at the price it announced (P01, P02: exact)
122	            asked = (self.facts.get(case.get("trigger_doc")) or {}).get("asked_price")
123	            pct = re.search(r"\+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?) ?%", case["title"])
124	            if asked or pct:
125	                return round(asked or current * (1 + float(pct[1]) / 100), 2)
126	        return round(ref * self._params(case, sup, i)["ratio"], 2)
127	
128	    def _standard(self, case):
129	        """The supplier's standard terms. Fitted: payment 30 days, volume = the buyer's need and contract
130	        12 months (what the real quotes state, P03/P10). Assumed: the slowest lead time, ppm 2.5x the loosest option."""
131	        std = {}
132	        for f in levers(case):
133	            o = case["term_options"].get(f) or [None]
134	            if f == "payment_days":
135	                std[f] = STD_PD if STD_PD in o else o[0]
136	            elif f == "volume_per_year":
137	                std[f] = case["buyer"]["need_per_year"]
138	            elif f == "lead_time_days":
139	                std[f] = o[-1]
140	            elif f == "ppm_commitment" and o[0] is not None:
141	                std[f] = round(max(o) * 2.5)
142	            else:
143	                std[f] = o[0]
144	        return std
145	
146	    def _init_thread(self, s, th, i):
147	        sup = s["case"]["suppliers"][i]
148	        p = self._params(s["case"], sup, i)
149	        th.update(p=p, ask=th["opening"], last_ov=None, pushes=0, floor=round(p["floor"] * th["opening"], 2))
150	        # the quote states the price and most standard terms; some it leaves out (fitted rates per field)
151	        th["first"] = {"unit_price": th["opening"], **{f: v for f, v in th["standard"].items() if f not in p["omit"]}}
152	
153	    def _bounds(self, case, ths):
154	        c_open = min(total_cost(case, {"unit_price": th["opening"]}, th["standard"]) for th in ths.values())
155	        c_best = min(
156	            package_cost(case, th["standard"], th["p"]["r"], th["floor"], th["p"]["pd_limit"], th["p"]["vol_cap"])
157	            for th in ths.values()
158	        )
159	        alt = case["buyer"].get("alternative") or {}
160	        if alt.get("terms", {}).get("unit_price"):
161	            c_best = min(c_best, total_cost(case, alt["terms"]))
162	        return c_open, (c_best if c_best < float("inf") else c_open)
163	
164	    # -- the supplier --------------------------------------------------------------------------
165	    def _value(self, s, th, terms):
166	        return supplier_value(s["case"], terms, {"standard": th["standard"], "interest_rate": th["p"]["r"]})
167	
168	    def _allowed(self, th, sheet):
169	        p = th["p"]
170	        return not (p["pd_limit"] and (sheet.get("payment_days") or 0) > p["pd_limit"]) and not capped(
171	            p["vol_cap"], sheet
172	        )
173	
174	    def _quote(self, s, th, asked, ask):
175	        """Our terms at its ask: the levers asked for (cut to its limits), the price that pays it `ask`."""
176	        p, case = th["p"], s["case"]
177	        t = {f: asked.get(f, th["standard"].get(f)) for f in levers(case)}
178	        if p["pd_limit"] and (t.get("payment_days") or 0) > p["pd_limit"]:
179	            t["payment_days"] = p["pd_limit"]
180	        if capped(p["vol_cap"], t):
181	            t["volume_per_year"] = max(o for o in case["term_options"]["volume_per_year"] if o <= p["vol_cap"])
182	        a = self._value(s, th, {**t, "unit_price": 0.0})
183	        b = self._value(s, th, {**t, "unit_price": 1.0}) - a
184	        return {"unit_price": round((ask - a) / b, 2), **t}
185	
186	    def _answer(self, s, th, msg, sheets):
187	        case, p = s["case"], th["p"]
188	        results, files = self._claims(s, th, msg)
189	        n_ver = sum(r["result"] == "verified" for r in results)
190	        ok = [t for t in sheets if self._allowed(th, t)]
191	        best = max(ok, key=lambda t: self._value(s, th, t), default=None)
192	        ov = self._value(s, th, best) if best else None
193	        open0, k, was_final = th["opening"], th["round"], th["status"] == "final_offer"
194	        accepted = lambda ask: ov is not None and ov >= ask * (1 - p["tol"])  # noqa: E731
195	        extra = " Which volume can you commit to?" if "volume_per_year" in case["negotiable"] else ""
196	        why = []
197	        if not sheets:
198	            reply = self._mail(s, th, th["status"], th["stated"], "We keep our offer." + extra, files)
199	            why.append("No term sheet: it keeps its offer.")
200	        elif accepted(th["ask"]):
201	            reply = self._mail(s, th, "agreed", best, "We agree.", [*files, "quote.pdf"])
202	            why.append(f"Your sheet is worth {ov:.2f} to it, its ask is {th['ask']:.2f}: it agrees.")
203	        elif was_final:
204	            th["pushes"] += 1
205	            if th["pushes"] >= p["walk_after"]:
206	                th["closed"] = "walked_away"
207	                reply = self._mail(s, th, "walked_away", th["stated"], "We end here.")
208	                why.append(f"You pushed {th['pushes']} time(s) past its final offer: it walks away.")
209	            else:
210	                terms = self._quote(s, th, best or sheets[0], th["ask"])
211	                reply = self._mail(s, th, "final_offer", terms, "Final offer, as before.", [*files, "quote.pdf"])
212	                why.append("Pushed past a final offer: it repeats it, priced for the terms you asked.")
213	        else:
214	            if k == 1:
215	                drop = (p["first_verified"] if n_ver else p["first"]) * open0
216	            elif ov is not None and ov - (th["last_ov"] or ov) >= 0.002 * open0:
217	                drop = p["g"] * (ov - th["last_ov"])
218	            else:
219	                drop = p["idle"] * open0
220	            if ov is not None:
221	                th["last_ov"] = ov
222	            th["ask"] = round(max(th["floor"], th["ask"] - drop), 2)
223	            if accepted(th["ask"]):
224	                reply = self._mail(s, th, "agreed", best, "We agree.", [*files, "quote.pdf"])
225	                why.append(f"It conceded to {th['ask']:.2f} and your sheet now meets it: it agrees.")
226	            else:
227	                final = k >= p["final_round"] or th["ask"] <= th["floor"] * 1.003
228	                terms = self._quote(s, th, best or sheets[0], th["ask"])
229	                status = "final_offer" if final else "open"
230	                reply = self._mail(
231	                    s,
232	                    th,
233	                    status,
234	                    terms,
235	                    ("Final offer." if final else "Our counter-offer.") + extra,
236	                    [*files, "quote.pdf"],
237	                )
238	                why.append(f"Ask {th['ask']:.2f} (drop {drop:.2f}); {'final' if final else 'open'}.")
239	        reply["claim_results"] = results
240	        s["trace"].append(
241	            {"round": th["round"], "actor": f"sup:{th['key']}", "move": structured(reply, th["round"]), "reasons": why}
242	        )
243	        return reply

1	"""Fit the real-like supplier from evidence: the 30 real practice dumps (sim_cases/real_runs), the
2	real case files (sim_cases/real) and the data package. Writes sim_cases/supplier_profile.json.
3	
4	    python -m arena_kit.fit_supplier [--data <data package>] [--out supplier_profile.json]
5	
6	Every parameter carries `status` ("fitted" with n samples, or "assumed" with no evidence), the
7	evidence it comes from and its uncertainty. Nothing is invented: what the dumps cannot show is
8	marked assumed. Reads local files only; never calls the arena.
9	"""
10	# ruff: noqa: E501  (the evidence texts of the profile are long sentences)
11	
12	import argparse
13	import glob
14	import itertools
15	import json
16	import sqlite3
17	import statistics as st
18	from pathlib import Path
19	
20	from .cost import total_cost
21	from .sim_real import levers, package_cost
22	
23	HERE = Path(__file__).parent / "sim_cases"
24	STD_PD = 30  # every supplier text in the dumps says "our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net"
25	
26	
27	def sheets(msg):
28	    """(price, payment_days) of each term sheet of a message; no payment days = the standard 30."""
29	    return [
30	        (x["terms"]["unit_price"], x["terms"].get("payment_days") or STD_PD)
31	        for x in (msg.get("term_sheets") or [])
32	        if x["terms"].get("unit_price")
33	    ]
34	
35	
36	def value(price, pd, r):
37	    """Cash-equivalent of a price at the standard payment days, for a supplier whose money costs r a year."""
38	    return price * (1 - r * (pd - STD_PD) / 360)
39	
40	
41	def q(xs, p):
42	    xs = sorted(xs)
43	    return xs[min(len(xs) - 1, int(p * len(xs)))] if xs else None
44	
45	
46	def spread(xs):
47	    return {"min": min(xs), "median": st.median(xs), "max": max(xs)} if xs else {}
48	
49	
50	def param(status, n, evidence, uncertainty, **vals):
51	    return {"status": status, "n": n, "evidence": evidence, "uncertainty": uncertainty, **vals}
52	
53	
54	def load():
55	    runs = []
56	    for f in sorted(glob.glob(str(HERE / "real_runs" / "*_P*.json"))):
57	        d = json.load(open(f))
58	        case = json.load(open(HERE / "real" / f"{d['case']}.json"))
59	        runs.append({"agent": d["agent"], "case_id": d["case"], "case": case, "d": d, "r": d["result"]})
60	    return runs
61	
62	
63	def pair_rates(msgs):
64	    """The supplier's cost of money r from messages that quote the same offer at two payment terms."""
65	    out = []
66	    for m in msgs:
67	        s = sheets(m)
68	        for (p1, d1), (p2, d2) in itertools.combinations(s, 2):
69	            if d1 != d2 and STD_PD in (d1, d2) and p1 and p2:  # equal-value pair: one is the standard term
70	                den = p1 * (d1 - STD_PD) - p2 * (d2 - STD_PD)
71	                if den and 0 < (r := 360 * (p1 - p2) / den) < 0.5:
72	                    out.append(r)
73	    return out
74	
75	
76	def standard_terms(case, run_results, quote=None):
77	    """The supplier's standard terms: fields it states in its opening quote, then non-negotiated fields
78	    (ppm, chargeback) from any deal on the case, then payment 30 / the first option for gaps."""
79	    std = {}
80	    for r in run_results:
81	        if r["terms"]:
82	            std = {k: v for k, v in r["terms"].items() if k not in case["negotiable"]}
83	            break
84	    for f in levers(case):
85	        o = case["term_options"].get(f) or [None]
86	        std[f] = STD_PD if f == "payment_days" else o[0]
87	    std.update({k: v for k, v in (quote or {}).items() if k != "unit_price"})
88	    return std
89	
90	
91	def implied_floor(case, std, r_s, c_best, opening):
92	    """The supplier's floor V (cash value per unit at its standard terms) that reproduces the arena's
93	    C_best: bisect V so that the cheapest package it would accept (every lever) costs c_best."""
94	    lo, hi = 0.2 * opening, 1.6 * opening
95	    if not package_cost(case, std, r_s, lo) < c_best < package_cost(case, std, r_s, hi):
96	        return None
97	    for _ in range(60):
98	        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
99	        lo, hi = (mid, hi) if package_cost(case, std, r_s, mid) < c_best else (lo, mid)
100	    return (lo + hi) / 2
101	
102	
103	def fit(data_dir):
104	    runs = load()
105	    by_case = {}
106	    for r in runs:
107	        by_case.setdefault(r["case_id"], []).append(r)
108	    P = {}
109	
110	    # -- supplier cost of money from price pairs at two payment terms --------------------------
111	    rates = {}
112	    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
113	        vals = [
114	            x
115	            for run in rs
116	            for t in run["d"]["threads"].values()
117	            for x in pair_rates([m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer"])
118	        ]
119	        if vals:
120	            rates[cid] = st.median(vals)
121	    r_all = st.median(rates.values())
122	    P["supplier_interest_rate"] = param(
123	        "fitted", len(rates),
124	        "price pairs in one supplier message at two payment terms (e.g. P01: 137.50 at 60 days vs 136.40 at 30)",
125	        f"per-case values {spread(list(rates.values()))}; the buyer rates in the cases are 0.04-0.12; per case rate not given by the arena",
126	        per_case={k: round(v, 4) for k, v in rates.items()}, min=round(min(rates.values()), 4),
127	        median=round(r_all, 4), max=round(max(rates.values()), 4),
128	    )  # fmt: skip
129	    P["standard_payment_days"] = param(
130	        "fitted", sum("standard Zahlungsziel is 30" in (m.get("body") or "") for run in runs for t in run["d"]["threads"].values() for m in t["messages"]),
131	        "the supplier texts say 'our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net' in every case that mentions it",
132	        "no counter-example in 30 dumps; the suppliers table has payment_days 30/45/60 for others (not used)",
133	        value=STD_PD,
134	    )  # fmt: skip
135	
136	    # -- opening price relative to the buyer's current/fallback price --------------------------
137	    opens, c_open_check, std_of = [], {}, {}
138	    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
139	        case, b = rs[0]["case"], rs[0]["case"]["buyer"]
140	        costs = []
141	        for sup, t in rs[0]["d"]["threads"].items():
142	            first = next(m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer")
143	            quote = first["term_sheets"][0]["terms"]
144	            op = quote["unit_price"]
145	            opens.append({"case": cid, "type": case["type"], "supplier": sup, "opening": op,
146	                          "vs_current": round(op / b["current_unit_price"], 4) if b.get("current_unit_price") else None,
147	                          "vs_fallback": round(op / b["fallback_unit_price"], 4)})  # fmt: skip
148	            std = standard_terms(case, [x["r"] for x in rs], quote)
149	            costs.append((total_cost(case, {f: std[f] for f in levers(case)} | {"unit_price": op}, std), op, std))
150	        c, op, std_of[cid] = min(costs, key=lambda x: x[0])
151	        # the arena's C_open = the cheapest opening quote: does it match our standard-terms recomputation?
152	        c_open_check[cid] = {
153	            "reported": rs[0]["r"]["c_open"],
154	            "recomputed_min": c,
155	            "match_pct": round(100 * (c / rs[0]["r"]["c_open"] - 1), 3),
156	        }
157	    cur = [o["vs_current"] for o in opens if o["vs_current"]]
158	    types = {}
159	    for o in opens:
160	        if o["vs_current"]:
161	            types.setdefault(o["type"], []).append(o["vs_current"])
162	    P["opening_vs_current_price"] = param(
163	        "fitted", len(cur),
164	        "first supplier quote / the case's current_unit_price, 10 hosted cases, 12 supplier threads",
165	        "ratio ranges 0.91 (bundling, below current) to 1.13; by case type only 1-2 samples each; P05 (rfq) has no current price",
166	        by_type={k: {"n": len(v), **spread(v)} for k, v in types.items()},
167	        pooled_excl_rfq=spread([x for k, v in types.items() if k != "rfq" for x in v]), **{k: v for k, v in spread(cur).items() if k != "n"},
168	        samples=sorted(cur),
169	    )  # fmt: skip
170	    facts = json.loads((Path(data_dir) / "facts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
171	    ann = []
172	    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
173	        asked = (facts.get(rs[0]["case"]["trigger_doc"]) or {}).get("asked_price")
174	        if asked:
175	            op = next(o["opening"] for o in opens if o["case"] == cid)
176	            ann.append({"case": cid, "asked_price": asked, "opening": op})
177	    P["opening_equals_announced_price"] = param(
178	        "fitted", len(ann), "price_increase letters (documents.asked_price) vs the supplier's opening quote",
179	        "P01 and P02 open exactly at the announced price; P13/P17 letters exist but were not played; other types have no letter (fitted ratio used)",
180	        pairs=ann,
181	    )  # fmt: skip
182	
183	    # -- which terms the opening quote states ------------------------------------------------------
184	    seen, st_n, tot_n = set(), {}, {}
185	    for run in runs:
186	        for sup, t in run["d"]["threads"].items():
187	            if (run["case_id"], sup) in seen:
188	                continue
189	            seen.add((run["case_id"], sup))
190	            stated = set(t["messages"][0]["term_sheets"][0]["terms"])
191	            for f in levers(run["case"]):
192	                tot_n[f], st_n[f] = tot_n.get(f, 0) + 1, st_n.get(f, 0) + (f in stated)
193	    P["opening_omits_field"] = param(
194	        "fitted", len(seen), "terms the first quote states vs leaves out (missing_fields), 12 supplier threads: payment_days omitted in 4 of 10, lead_time_days 2 of 4 (rfq P05), chargeback 1 of 1",
195	        "small counts per field; other fields were always stated (contract_months 6/6, index_clause 3/3, volume 2/2, ppm 1/1); fields not in the list default to 0",
196	        rates={f: {"omit": round(1 - st_n[f] / tot_n[f], 3), "n": tot_n[f]} for f in tot_n},

199	    # -- floor implied by the arena's own C_best -------------------------------------------------
200	    floors, floor_rows, ftypes = [], {}, {}
201	    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
202	        case, res = rs[0]["case"], rs[0]["r"]
203	        std = std_of[cid]
204	        ok = abs(c_open_check[cid]["match_pct"]) < 0.5
205	        ops = [o["opening"] for o in opens if o["case"] == cid]
206	        row = {"c_open_matches": ok, "c_best": res["c_best"], "c_open": res["c_open"]}
207	        if ok and res["c_best"] < (res["c_alt"] or 1e18) - 1:
208	            r_s = rates.get(cid, r_all)
209	            lo = implied_floor(case, std, min(r_s, r_all) * 0.7, res["c_best"], min(ops))
210	            mid = implied_floor(case, std, r_s, res["c_best"], min(ops))
211	            hi = implied_floor(case, std, max(r_s, r_all) * 1.3, res["c_best"], min(ops))
212	            row.update(floor_ratio=round(mid / min(ops), 4) if mid else None,
213	                       floor_ratio_range=[round(x / min(ops), 4) for x in (lo, hi) if x],
214	                       r_used=round(r_s, 4), rate_fitted=cid in rates)  # fmt: skip
215	            if mid:
216	                floors.append(mid / min(ops))

218	        floor_rows[cid] = row
219	    P["floor_vs_opening"] = param(
220	        "fitted", len(floors),
221	        "the supplier's cheapest accepted package: V such that the cheapest lever package at V costs the arena's C_best (cost.supplier_value, cost.total_cost); ratio V / best opening quote",
222	        "assumes C_best = supplier_value floor with every lever (brief.md section 6); standard terms rebuilt from the deals; rate varies +-30%; "
223	        "the floors of P03/P07/P08/P18 lie far below anything a supplier conceded (it froze first), so they bound room, not behaviour",
224	        per_case=floor_rows, by_type={k: {"n": len(v), **{x: round(y, 4) for x, y in spread(v).items()}} for k, v in ftypes.items()}, **{k: round(v, 4) for k, v in spread(floors).items() if k != "n"}, samples=sorted(round(f, 4) for f in floors),
225	    )  # fmt: skip
226	
227	    # -- concession, final offer, walk-away, claims --------------------------------------------
228	    g_runs, idle_steps, step1_claims, step1_plain, step1_multi, pass_rows = [], [], [], [], [], []
229	    finals, walks, last_ask_ratio, accepts = [], [], [], []
230	    for run in runs:
231	        cid, b = run["case_id"], run["case"]["buyer"]
232	        r_s = rates.get(cid, r_all)
233	        for sup, t in run["d"]["threads"].items():

235	            B = [m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] == "buyer" and sheets(m)]

239	            bv = [max(value(p, d, r_s) for p, d in sheets(m)) for m in B]
240	            o = sv[0]
241	            fin = next((i for i, m in enumerate(S) if m["status"] == "final_offer"), None)
242	            if fin is not None:
243	                last_ask_ratio.append(sv[fin] / o)
244	            finals.append({"run": run["agent"] + "_" + cid, "supplier": sup, "round": fin,
245	                           "idle_moves_before": sum(1 for i in range(1, min(fin or 0, len(bv))) if bv[i] - bv[i - 1] < 0.002 * o) if fin else None,
246	                           "buyer_moves_before": min(fin or 0, len(B))})  # fmt: skip
247	            end = min(fin if fin is not None else len(S) - 1, len(S) - 1)
248	            dsum = bsum = 0.0
249	            for i in range(1, end + 1):
250	                if sv[i] is None or i - 1 >= len(bv):
251	                    break
252	                ds = sv[i - 1] - sv[i]
253	                n_ver = sum(c.get("result") == "verified" for c in (S[i].get("claim_results") or []))
254	                if i == 1:
255	                    (
256	                        step1_multi if len(run["case"]["suppliers"]) > 1 else step1_claims if n_ver else step1_plain
257	                    ).append((ds / o, n_ver))
258	                    continue
259	                db = bv[i - 1] - bv[i - 2] if i >= 2 and i - 1 < len(bv) else 0
260	                if db < 0.002 * o:
261	                    idle_steps.append(ds / o)
262	                else:
263	                    dsum, bsum = dsum + ds, bsum + db
264	                pass_rows.append((cid, round(db / o, 4), round(ds / o, 4)))
265	            if bsum > 0.01 * o:
266	                g_runs.append(dsum / bsum)
267	            # walk-away / agreement after final: pushes that did not meet the ask
268	            if fin is not None:
269	                pushes = [m for m in B[fin:] if sheets(m)]
270	                walked = S[-1]["status"] == "walked_away"
271	                (walks if walked else accepts).append(
272	                    {"run": run["agent"] + "_" + cid, "supplier": sup, "pushes_after_final": len(pushes)}
273	                )
274	    P["concession_pass_through"] = param(
275	        "fitted", len(g_runs), "per thread: sum(supplier ask drop) / sum(our rise in the best offer's value), rounds 2..final, rounds where we moved >0.2% of the opening",
276	        "range is wide (P02 about 0.02: supplier froze while we moved 10 EUR; P01 about 0.4-0.6); case dependent, not predictable from case fields",
277	        **spread([round(g, 3) for g in g_runs]), samples=sorted(round(g, 3) for g in g_runs),
278	    )  # fmt: skip
279	    P["idle_step"] = param(
280	        "fitted", len(idle_steps), "supplier ask drop per round (share of opening) in rounds where we moved <0.2% of the opening",
281	        "mostly 0 or tiny; sometimes a small step; samples listed", **spread([round(x, 4) for x in idle_steps]), samples=sorted(round(x, 4) for x in idle_steps),
282	    )  # fmt: skip
283	    P["first_reply_drop_with_verified_claims"] = param(
284	        "fitted", len(step1_claims), "first supplier reply drop (share of opening) when it verified >=1 cited fact (evidence_router runs)",

286	        samples=[round(x, 4) for x, _ in step1_claims],
287	    )  # fmt: skip

289	        "fitted", len(step1_plain), "first supplier reply drop (share of opening), single-supplier cases, no verified claim",
290	        "negative values (supplier raised its price for 90 days) are kept as measured; the mock clips them to 0", samples=sorted(round(x, 4) for x, _ in step1_plain),
291	    )  # fmt: skip
292	    P["first_reply_drop_multi_supplier"] = param(
293	        "fitted", len(step1_multi), "first reply drop in P05 (rfq, 3 suppliers compete): much larger than single-supplier",
294	        "one case, three suppliers, five runs; assumed to generalise to every case with >1 supplier", samples=sorted(round(x, 4) for x, _ in step1_multi),
295	    )  # fmt: skip
296	    fr = [f["round"] for f in finals if f["round"] is not None]
297	    P["final_offer_round"] = param(
298	        "fitted", len(fr), "reply index of the first final_offer in each supplier thread (30 runs)",
299	        f"{len(finals) - len(fr)} threads never sent one (agreed at once, or the run ended); depends little on how much we moved; round limit is 10",
300	        **spread(fr), samples=sorted(fr), threads=finals,
301	    )  # fmt: skip
302	    wp = [w["pushes_after_final"] for w in walks]

"""Fit the real-like supplier from evidence: the 30 real practice dumps (sim_cases/real_runs), the
real case files (sim_cases/real) and the data package. Writes sim_cases/supplier_profile.json.

    python -m arena_kit.fit_supplier [--data <data package>] [--out supplier_profile.json]

Every parameter carries `status` ("fitted" with n samples, or "assumed" with no evidence), the
evidence it comes from and its uncertainty. Nothing is invented: what the dumps cannot show is
marked assumed. Reads local files only; never calls the arena.
"""
# ruff: noqa: E501  (the evidence texts of the profile are long sentences)

import argparse
import glob
import itertools
import json
import sqlite3
import statistics as st
from pathlib import Path

from .cost import total_cost
from .sim_real import levers, package_cost

HERE = Path(__file__).parent / "sim_cases"
STD_PD = 30  # every supplier text in the dumps says "our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net"


def sheets(msg):
    """(price, payment_days) of each term sheet of a message; no payment days = the standard 30."""
    return [
        (x["terms"]["unit_price"], x["terms"].get("payment_days") or STD_PD)
        for x in (msg.get("term_sheets") or [])
        if x["terms"].get("unit_price")
    ]


def value(price, pd, r):
    """Cash-equivalent of a price at the standard payment days, for a supplier whose money costs r a year."""
    return price * (1 - r * (pd - STD_PD) / 360)


def q(xs, p):
    xs = sorted(xs)
    return xs[min(len(xs) - 1, int(p * len(xs)))] if xs else None


def spread(xs):
    return {"min": min(xs), "median": st.median(xs), "max": max(xs)} if xs else {}


def param(status, n, evidence, uncertainty, **vals):
    return {"status": status, "n": n, "evidence": evidence, "uncertainty": uncertainty, **vals}


def load():
    runs = []
    for f in sorted(glob.glob(str(HERE / "real_runs" / "*_P*.json"))):
        d = json.load(open(f))
        case = json.load(open(HERE / "real" / f"{d['case']}.json"))
        runs.append({"agent": d["agent"], "case_id": d["case"], "case": case, "d": d, "r": d["result"]})
    return runs


def pair_rates(msgs):
    """The supplier's cost of money r from messages that quote the same offer at two payment terms."""
    out = []
    for m in msgs:
        s = sheets(m)
        for (p1, d1), (p2, d2) in itertools.combinations(s, 2):
            if d1 != d2 and STD_PD in (d1, d2) and p1 and p2:  # equal-value pair: one is the standard term
                den = p1 * (d1 - STD_PD) - p2 * (d2 - STD_PD)
                if den and 0 < (r := 360 * (p1 - p2) / den) < 0.5:
                    out.append(r)
    return out


def standard_terms(case, run_results, quote=None):
    """The supplier's standard terms: fields it states in its opening quote, then non-negotiated fields
    (ppm, chargeback) from any deal on the case, then payment 30 / the first option for gaps."""
    std = {}
    for r in run_results:
        if r["terms"]:
            std = {k: v for k, v in r["terms"].items() if k not in case["negotiable"]}
            break
    for f in levers(case):
        o = case["term_options"].get(f) or [None]
        std[f] = STD_PD if f == "payment_days" else o[0]
    std.update({k: v for k, v in (quote or {}).items() if k != "unit_price"})
    return std


def implied_floor(case, std, r_s, c_best, opening):
    """The supplier's floor V (cash value per unit at its standard terms) that reproduces the arena's
    C_best: bisect V so that the cheapest package it would accept (every lever) costs c_best."""
    lo, hi = 0.2 * opening, 1.6 * opening
    if not package_cost(case, std, r_s, lo) < c_best < package_cost(case, std, r_s, hi):
        return None
    for _ in range(60):
        mid = (lo + hi) / 2
        lo, hi = (mid, hi) if package_cost(case, std, r_s, mid) < c_best else (lo, mid)
    return (lo + hi) / 2


def fit(data_dir):
    runs = load()
    by_case = {}
    for r in runs:
        by_case.setdefault(r["case_id"], []).append(r)
    P = {}

    # -- supplier cost of money from price pairs at two payment terms --------------------------
    rates = {}
    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
        vals = [
            x
            for run in rs
            for t in run["d"]["threads"].values()
            for x in pair_rates([m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer"])
        ]
        if vals:
            rates[cid] = st.median(vals)
    r_all = st.median(rates.values())
    P["supplier_interest_rate"] = param(
        "fitted", len(rates),
        "price pairs in one supplier message at two payment terms (e.g. P01: 137.50 at 60 days vs 136.40 at 30)",
        f"per-case values {spread(list(rates.values()))}; the buyer rates in the cases are 0.04-0.12; per case rate not given by the arena",
        per_case={k: round(v, 4) for k, v in rates.items()}, min=round(min(rates.values()), 4),
        median=round(r_all, 4), max=round(max(rates.values()), 4),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["standard_payment_days"] = param(
        "fitted", sum("standard Zahlungsziel is 30" in (m.get("body") or "") for run in runs for t in run["d"]["threads"].values() for m in t["messages"]),
        "the supplier texts say 'our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net' in every case that mentions it",
        "no counter-example in 30 dumps; the suppliers table has payment_days 30/45/60 for others (not used)",
        value=STD_PD,
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- opening price relative to the buyer's current/fallback price --------------------------
    opens, c_open_check, std_of = [], {}, {}
    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
        case, b = rs[0]["case"], rs[0]["case"]["buyer"]
        costs = []
        for sup, t in rs[0]["d"]["threads"].items():
            first = next(m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer")
            quote = first["term_sheets"][0]["terms"]
            op = quote["unit_price"]
            opens.append({"case": cid, "type": case["type"], "supplier": sup, "opening": op,
                          "vs_current": round(op / b["current_unit_price"], 4) if b.get("current_unit_price") else None,
                          "vs_fallback": round(op / b["fallback_unit_price"], 4)})  # fmt: skip
            std = standard_terms(case, [x["r"] for x in rs], quote)
            costs.append((total_cost(case, {f: std[f] for f in levers(case)} | {"unit_price": op}, std), op, std))
        c, op, std_of[cid] = min(costs, key=lambda x: x[0])
        # the arena's C_open = the cheapest opening quote: does it match our standard-terms recomputation?
        c_open_check[cid] = {
            "reported": rs[0]["r"]["c_open"],
            "recomputed_min": c,
            "match_pct": round(100 * (c / rs[0]["r"]["c_open"] - 1), 3),
        }
    cur = [o["vs_current"] for o in opens if o["vs_current"]]
    types = {}
    for o in opens:
        if o["vs_current"]:
            types.setdefault(o["type"], []).append(o["vs_current"])
    P["opening_vs_current_price"] = param(
        "fitted", len(cur),
        "first supplier quote / the case's current_unit_price, 10 hosted cases, 12 supplier threads",
        "ratio ranges 0.91 (bundling, below current) to 1.13; by case type only 1-2 samples each; P05 (rfq) has no current price",
        by_type={k: {"n": len(v), **spread(v)} for k, v in types.items()},
        pooled_excl_rfq=spread([x for k, v in types.items() if k != "rfq" for x in v]), **{k: v for k, v in spread(cur).items() if k != "n"},
        samples=sorted(cur),
    )  # fmt: skip
    facts = json.loads((Path(data_dir) / "facts.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    ann = []
    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
        asked = (facts.get(rs[0]["case"]["trigger_doc"]) or {}).get("asked_price")
        if asked:
            op = next(o["opening"] for o in opens if o["case"] == cid)
            ann.append({"case": cid, "asked_price": asked, "opening": op})
    P["opening_equals_announced_price"] = param(
        "fitted", len(ann), "price_increase letters (documents.asked_price) vs the supplier's opening quote",
        "P01 and P02 open exactly at the announced price; P13/P17 letters exist but were not played; other types have no letter (fitted ratio used)",
        pairs=ann,
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- which terms the opening quote states ------------------------------------------------------
    seen, st_n, tot_n = set(), {}, {}
    for run in runs:
        for sup, t in run["d"]["threads"].items():
            if (run["case_id"], sup) in seen:
                continue
            seen.add((run["case_id"], sup))
            stated = set(t["messages"][0]["term_sheets"][0]["terms"])
            for f in levers(run["case"]):
                tot_n[f], st_n[f] = tot_n.get(f, 0) + 1, st_n.get(f, 0) + (f in stated)
    P["opening_omits_field"] = param(
        "fitted", len(seen), "terms the first quote states vs leaves out (missing_fields), 12 supplier threads: payment_days omitted in 4 of 10, lead_time_days 2 of 4 (rfq P05), chargeback 1 of 1",
        "small counts per field; other fields were always stated (contract_months 6/6, index_clause 3/3, volume 2/2, ppm 1/1); fields not in the list default to 0",
        rates={f: {"omit": round(1 - st_n[f] / tot_n[f], 3), "n": tot_n[f]} for f in tot_n},
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- floor implied by the arena's own C_best -------------------------------------------------
    floors, floor_rows, ftypes = [], {}, {}
    for cid, rs in by_case.items():
        case, res = rs[0]["case"], rs[0]["r"]
        std = std_of[cid]
        ok = abs(c_open_check[cid]["match_pct"]) < 0.5
        ops = [o["opening"] for o in opens if o["case"] == cid]
        row = {"c_open_matches": ok, "c_best": res["c_best"], "c_open": res["c_open"]}
        if ok and res["c_best"] < (res["c_alt"] or 1e18) - 1:
            r_s = rates.get(cid, r_all)
            lo = implied_floor(case, std, min(r_s, r_all) * 0.7, res["c_best"], min(ops))
            mid = implied_floor(case, std, r_s, res["c_best"], min(ops))
            hi = implied_floor(case, std, max(r_s, r_all) * 1.3, res["c_best"], min(ops))
            row.update(floor_ratio=round(mid / min(ops), 4) if mid else None,
                       floor_ratio_range=[round(x / min(ops), 4) for x in (lo, hi) if x],
                       r_used=round(r_s, 4), rate_fitted=cid in rates)  # fmt: skip
            if mid:
                floors.append(mid / min(ops))
                ftypes.setdefault(case["type"], []).append(mid / min(ops))
        floor_rows[cid] = row
    P["floor_vs_opening"] = param(
        "fitted", len(floors),
        "the supplier's cheapest accepted package: V such that the cheapest lever package at V costs the arena's C_best (cost.supplier_value, cost.total_cost); ratio V / best opening quote",
        "assumes C_best = supplier_value floor with every lever (brief.md section 6); standard terms rebuilt from the deals; rate varies +-30%; "
        "the floors of P03/P07/P08/P18 lie far below anything a supplier conceded (it froze first), so they bound room, not behaviour",
        per_case=floor_rows, by_type={k: {"n": len(v), **{x: round(y, 4) for x, y in spread(v).items()}} for k, v in ftypes.items()}, **{k: round(v, 4) for k, v in spread(floors).items() if k != "n"}, samples=sorted(round(f, 4) for f in floors),
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- concession, final offer, walk-away, claims --------------------------------------------
    g_runs, idle_steps, step1_claims, step1_plain, step1_multi, pass_rows = [], [], [], [], [], []
    finals, walks, last_ask_ratio, accepts = [], [], [], []
    for run in runs:
        cid, b = run["case_id"], run["case"]["buyer"]
        r_s = rates.get(cid, r_all)
        for sup, t in run["d"]["threads"].items():
            S = [m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] != "buyer"]
            B = [m for m in t["messages"] if m["from"] == "buyer" and sheets(m)]
            if not S or not sheets(S[0]):
                continue
            sv = [value(*sheets(m)[0], r_s) if sheets(m) else None for m in S]
            bv = [max(value(p, d, r_s) for p, d in sheets(m)) for m in B]
            o = sv[0]
            fin = next((i for i, m in enumerate(S) if m["status"] == "final_offer"), None)
            if fin is not None:
                last_ask_ratio.append(sv[fin] / o)
            finals.append({"run": run["agent"] + "_" + cid, "supplier": sup, "round": fin,
                           "idle_moves_before": sum(1 for i in range(1, min(fin or 0, len(bv))) if bv[i] - bv[i - 1] < 0.002 * o) if fin else None,
                           "buyer_moves_before": min(fin or 0, len(B))})  # fmt: skip
            end = min(fin if fin is not None else len(S) - 1, len(S) - 1)
            dsum = bsum = 0.0
            for i in range(1, end + 1):
                if sv[i] is None or i - 1 >= len(bv):
                    break
                ds = sv[i - 1] - sv[i]
                n_ver = sum(c.get("result") == "verified" for c in (S[i].get("claim_results") or []))
                if i == 1:
                    (
                        step1_multi if len(run["case"]["suppliers"]) > 1 else step1_claims if n_ver else step1_plain
                    ).append((ds / o, n_ver))
                    continue
                db = bv[i - 1] - bv[i - 2] if i >= 2 and i - 1 < len(bv) else 0
                if db < 0.002 * o:
                    idle_steps.append(ds / o)
                else:
                    dsum, bsum = dsum + ds, bsum + db
                pass_rows.append((cid, round(db / o, 4), round(ds / o, 4)))
            if bsum > 0.01 * o:
                g_runs.append(dsum / bsum)
            # walk-away / agreement after final: pushes that did not meet the ask
            if fin is not None:
                pushes = [m for m in B[fin:] if sheets(m)]
                walked = S[-1]["status"] == "walked_away"
                (walks if walked else accepts).append(
                    {"run": run["agent"] + "_" + cid, "supplier": sup, "pushes_after_final": len(pushes)}
                )
    P["concession_pass_through"] = param(
        "fitted", len(g_runs), "per thread: sum(supplier ask drop) / sum(our rise in the best offer's value), rounds 2..final, rounds where we moved >0.2% of the opening",
        "range is wide (P02 about 0.02: supplier froze while we moved 10 EUR; P01 about 0.4-0.6); case dependent, not predictable from case fields",
        **spread([round(g, 3) for g in g_runs]), samples=sorted(round(g, 3) for g in g_runs),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["idle_step"] = param(
        "fitted", len(idle_steps), "supplier ask drop per round (share of opening) in rounds where we moved <0.2% of the opening",
        "mostly 0 or tiny; sometimes a small step; samples listed", **spread([round(x, 4) for x in idle_steps]), samples=sorted(round(x, 4) for x in idle_steps),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["first_reply_drop_with_verified_claims"] = param(
        "fitted", len(step1_claims), "first supplier reply drop (share of opening) when it verified >=1 cited fact (evidence_router runs)",
        "tiny sample; supplier text also moves the effective date after a verified notice-period claim (P01)",
        samples=[round(x, 4) for x, _ in step1_claims],
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["first_reply_drop_plain"] = param(
        "fitted", len(step1_plain), "first supplier reply drop (share of opening), single-supplier cases, no verified claim",
        "negative values (supplier raised its price for 90 days) are kept as measured; the mock clips them to 0", samples=sorted(round(x, 4) for x, _ in step1_plain),
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["first_reply_drop_multi_supplier"] = param(
        "fitted", len(step1_multi), "first reply drop in P05 (rfq, 3 suppliers compete): much larger than single-supplier",
        "one case, three suppliers, five runs; assumed to generalise to every case with >1 supplier", samples=sorted(round(x, 4) for x, _ in step1_multi),
    )  # fmt: skip
    fr = [f["round"] for f in finals if f["round"] is not None]
    P["final_offer_round"] = param(
        "fitted", len(fr), "reply index of the first final_offer in each supplier thread (30 runs)",
        f"{len(finals) - len(fr)} threads never sent one (agreed at once, or the run ended); depends little on how much we moved; round limit is 10",
        **spread(fr), samples=sorted(fr), threads=finals,
    )  # fmt: skip
    wp = [w["pushes_after_final"] for w in walks]
    P["walk_after_pushes_post_final"] = param(
        "fitted", len(wp), "pushes (our term sheets that did not meet the ask) after final_offer before the supplier walked away",
        "walks: P05 70210 (4), 70250 (1 and 3), P10 (1,1,1). Not walks: P01 2 pushes then price re-quoted for 90 days, P07 1 push matched",
        samples=sorted(wp), walks=walks, no_walk=accepts,
    )  # fmt: skip
    P["final_offer_ask_vs_opening"] = param(
        "fitted", len(last_ask_ratio), "value of the final_offer / opening value (at the standard payment days)",
        "the supplier's frozen position: how far it actually came down in 30 runs", **spread([round(x, 4) for x in last_ask_ratio]),
        samples=sorted(round(x, 4) for x in last_ask_ratio),
    )  # fmt: skip

    # -- term trades and hard limits ---------------------------------------------------------
    texts = [
        (run["case_id"], s, m.get("body") or "")
        for run in runs
        for s, t in run["d"]["threads"].items()
        for m in t["messages"]
        if m["from"] != "buyer"
    ]
    limit_threads = {(c, s) for c, s, b in texts if "absolute limit" in b and "30 days" in b}
    all_threads = {(c, s) for c, s, _ in texts}
    cap_threads = {(c, s) for c, s, b in texts if "allocation cap" in b}
    P["payment_days_trade"] = param(
        "fitted", len(rates), "= supplier_interest_rate: a longer payment term costs the buyer about r * days / 360 of the price",
        "pairs fit one rate per case with spread; whether the supplier accepts 90 days at all is the hard limit below",

"""Generate varied cases in the schema of the real case files (sim_cases/real) from real data rows.

    python -m arena_kit.gen_cases [--data <data package>] [--n 30] [--seed 1]

Writes sim_cases/gen_dev/ and sim_cases/gen_test/ (n cases each). Each case takes a real template of
its type (the structure: negotiable fields, options, must-have kinds, alternative kind) and moves it to
another supplier/part pair of the data package: the current price is the pair's latest price_conditions
row, the need comes from its purchase orders, refs are real IDs (contract, scorecard, quote, cost, doc).
The development and the held-out set use disjoint PARTS (hash split), so tuning on dev never sees a test
part. Reproducible: the same --seed gives the same files. Reads local files only.

What is varied is NOT all observed in the real cases: every real case has interest rate 0.08 and payment
reference 60 days, horizons are 1 and 2 years only; the generator varies them (assumed, see README).
"""
# ruff: noqa: E501  (long text templates)

"""Generate varied cases in the schema of the real case files (sim_cases/real) from real data rows.

    python -m arena_kit.gen_cases [--data <data package>] [--n 30] [--seed 1]

Writes sim_cases/gen_dev/ and sim_cases/gen_test/ (n cases each). Each case takes a real template of
its type (the structure: negotiable fields, options, must-have kinds, alternative kind) and moves it to
another supplier/part pair of the data package: the current price is the pair's latest price_conditions
row, the need comes from its purchase orders, refs are real IDs (contract, scorecard, quote, cost, doc).
The development and the held-out set use disjoint PARTS (hash split), so tuning on dev never sees a test
part. Reproducible: the same --seed gives the same files. Reads local files only.

What is varied is NOT all observed in the real cases: every real case has interest rate 0.08 and payment
reference 60 days, horizons are 1 and 2 years only; the generator varies them (assumed, see README).
"""
# ruff: noqa: E501  (long text templates)

import argparse
import glob
import json
import random
